economy.zh:
今日全球市场在美伊冲突升级与AI板块剧烈分化中震荡。美国突袭伊朗后油价飙升，欧洲股市承压；FOMC维持利率不变但长端收益率跳升，市场质疑美联储抗通胀决心。科技股方面，微软财报强劲并扩大资本开支，但AI板块整体下行，中际旭创港股首日破发，科创50跌超6%。中国央行加码逆回购维稳资金面，金饰价格突破1239元/克。后续观察美伊冲突对能源通胀的传导、FOMC会后言论对加息预期的影响，以及AI投资从硬件向应用端轮动的可能。

- **[U.S. strikes Iran after surprise missile attack, dashing hopes of de-escalation](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/us-iran-war-hormuz-centcom-trump-.html)** — 美国与伊朗全面开战，霍尔木兹海峡危机深化，全球油价面临进一步上行压力。
- **[Microsoft jumps 8% as it boosts capital spending plans, citing demand](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/microsoft-msft-q4-earnings-report-2026.html)** — 微软财报超预期并上调资本开支，股价大涨8%，带动科技巨头AI军备竞赛预期。
- **[Federal Reserve issues FOMC statement](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/monetary20260729a.htm)** — 美联储维持利率不变，但长期国债收益率走高，市场对主席Warsh的信用产生质疑。
- **[China threatens retaliation against U.S. humanoid robot ban](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/china-us-robot-humanoid-ban-trump-visit.html)** — 中国商务部威胁反制美国对人形机器人的禁令，中美科技脱钩再添新战线。
- **[Zhongji Innolight shares fall on Hong Kong debut amid global AI sell-off](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3362321/zhongji-innolight-shares-fall-hong-kong-debut-amid-global-ai-sell)** — 中际旭创港股上市首日跌近3%，反映AI光模块短期估值压力。
- **[ECB wage tracker at 2.7% in Q1 2027](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260729~4ad7508d8a.en.html)** — 欧央行工资跟踪器显示谈判工资增速稳定在2.7%，为后续政策提供参考。
- **[多家金店金饰价格集体上涨，最高报1239元/克](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBiV0ZHLW1wUUNfWWVkZU53ZmdneTFxMDZlXzJ6TkFvVXFPNm12TVVURnN1bGcwRE9iM25DaUtQeXdEcThzUUhKWTNKb1VCZEhELS1JZ0ZhZlkxeVhGekE)** — 国内金价受避险情绪推动创历史新高，投资者关注黄金配置机会。

**后续观察**：美伊冲突是否引发更大范围供应中断，以及FOMC后续言论对市场的引导。AI板块内部估值分化加剧，建议关注业绩确定性强的算力基础设施与下游应用端。
economy.en:
Global markets are navigating a volatile landscape shaped by the sudden escalation of US-Iran military conflict, which has driven oil prices higher and dampened risk appetite, even as strong tech earnings from Microsoft and Samsung provide a counterbalance. The Federal Reserve's decision to hold rates steady has drawn criticism over its commitment to fighting inflation, while China accelerates its semiconductor self-sufficiency push with major IPOs and component demand. The following developments defined the past 24 hours:

- **US-Iran conflict reignites**: US forces launched strikes against Iran following a surprise missile attack, dashing hopes of de-escalation and pushing oil prices higher ([US strikes Iran](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/us-iran-war-hormuz-centcom-trump-.html)). The Strait of Hormuz remains a critical flashpoint, with Iran rejecting an Omani proposal ([Oil climbs](https://news.google.)).

- **Microsoft surges 8% on earnings**: The tech giant boosted capital spending plans, citing strong AI demand, and signaled positive free cash flow for the new fiscal year ([Microsoft jumps](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/microsoft-msft-q4-earnings-report-2026.html)). This helped offset broader market jitters.

- **Fed credibility under fire**: The FOMC left rates unchanged, but long-term Treasury yields jumped as investors question whether Chairman Warsh will act forcefully enough on inflation ([Fed credibility](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/kevin-warsh-fed-treasury-yields-inflation-credibility-interest-rates.html)).

- **China threatens retaliation over US robot ban**: Beijing said the US humanoid robot ban 'severely damages' relations and hinted at countermeasures ([China threatens](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/china-us-robot-humanoid-ban-trump-visit.html)). The US wants Asia to use its AI, but China dominates cheaper models ([US vs China AI](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/us-wants-asia-to-use-its-ai-but-china-dominates-cheaper-models.html)).

- **BMW to cut up to 8,000 jobs** in Germany under pressure from Chinese rivals, highlighting the competitive threat to European automakers ([BMW cuts](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/29/bmw-cut-jobs-germany-pressure-chinese-rivals)).

- **China's AI supply chain goes public**: Zhongji Innolight, a key optical transceiver maker, fell on its Hong Kong debut amid a global AI sell-off ([Innolight falls](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3362321/zhongji-innolight-shares-fall-hong-kong-debut-amid-global-ai-sell)). Meanwhile, CXMT's $9.8 billion Shanghai IPO signaled China's growing DRAM capabilities ([CXMT shock](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3362256/cxmt-shock-how-chinas-viable-alternatives-punch-nvidia-micron-sk-hynix-shares)).

- **ECB wage tracker stable at 2.7%**, but higher energy prices from the Iran conflict could force the ECB to reconsider its rate path ([ECB wage](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260729~4ad7508d8a.en.html), [Inflation outlook](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxQMTVsc09UelEyZEpja19WcExTTmt2aFFmQ2gyd0wwSHZ2a3ZYRFdLOG9NMTR2X09CLW0yYzZoRVBDc1Zhc0M5NlI3WTFIMHhISzNzdVJ2TzYtTXFuSTFNZjdrdm1EQ21uLVlUYWdRSTAwSWVYbGRzYXZSRl84TGowc0pRUDRYNDdySGlRWTVMX0c1VHk2ckJ1ZjcxVlRkb2F3by16c2pFanAxazNMSUoxd1d0dTVxS0ZZenhR)).

**Watch next**: All eyes are on the trajectory of US-Iran tensions and their impact on oil prices and global risk sentiment. The Fed's next moves will be scrutinized as inflation expectations adjust. In tech, the AI earnings season continues to bifurcate winners (Microsoft, Samsung) from suppliers exposed to cyclical demand (Innolight). Europe's economic resilience will be tested by both energy costs and Chinese competition, while China's AI self-sufficiency drive accelerates with new listings and component surpluses.

society.zh:
过去24小时，全球社会新闻呈现三重焦点：中东冲突骤然升级——美国对伊朗发动“重型”打击，沙特被卷入战火，加沙与黎巴嫩局势同步恶化；日本熊本县发生强烈地震，导致AEON购物中心坍塌，救援仍在进行；欧洲多地山火肆虐，希腊三名消防员殉职，法国持续40℃高温。此外，文化科技领域也有重要动态：萨尔曼·拉什迪袭击者被定罪，数学家王虹与邓煜获菲尔兹奖引发中文社区热议。以下为各区域详细追踪。

- **中东战火扩大：美伊互袭，沙特陷入两难**。美国在伊朗试图攻击美军后发动“重型”打击（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c74gwdzywmeo)），沙特虽试图置身事外却被迫卷入（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clyx83l8jv8o)），美沙联手打击伊拉克境内伊朗支持的民兵（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/29/nx-s1-5911806)）。同时，以色列空袭加沙城沙提难民营（[半岛](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/30/israeli-strikes-leave-buildings-burning-in-gaza-city)），黎巴嫩南部村庄因以军“黄线”分裂（[半岛](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/30/living-with-fear-inside-a-southern-lebanon-village-divided-by-israel)）。冲突已冲击全球能源市场，韩国KOSPI指数6%下跌即为明证（[MyChamplainValley](https://news.google.)）。

- **日本熊本7.0级地震：AEON Mall坍塌，搜救“争分夺秒”**。地震发生在29日，导致熊本AEON购物中心严重损毁，首相高市早苗称“与时间赛跑”救援（[半岛](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/30/like-volcanic-ash-falling-inside-aeon-mall-after-japans-earthquake)）。该商场10年前曾因地震重建，刚重新开放（[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE4yamF6S1ZkU1JLQ0xpM3pjeVVMcjB6WldCUzM2UmMycGJSN2NBcTRjbFBiaG5WSllUcHlWMEJGeEQzLVYycEJfSTM0bkd0UG9hdF90YVYtWC1fbXdsb1cyazhzdjE2aVFPWTg2QjNWSVprQTA4VV90THNuOTU)）。韩国外交部通报无韩国公民伤亡（[koreatimes](https://news.google.)）。

- **欧洲山火：希腊三名消防员牺牲，法国居民拒绝撤离**。希腊克里特岛遭强风助长野火，三名消防员殉职（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyjgwg8jddo)）。法国吉伦特地区40℃高温下，部分居民拒绝撤离（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c62q5we799ro)）。

- **萨尔曼·拉什迪袭击者被判恐怖主义罪**。28岁的哈迪·马塔尔被认定试图协助真主党，袭击作者（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c86ng1g5wy4o)）。

- **演员杰瑞德·莱托被10名女性指控性侵**。其中包括未成年指控，警方已展开调查（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd7lg2nz2x2o)）。

- **韩国女性网络侦探对抗AI深度伪造色情**。一群女性志愿者利用技术追踪合成淫秽影像，反映数字性犯罪治理难题（[Japan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOVXp2ZXZVYXdRZmhmRWN0NU9iZE5NSDduVjdhYkIxN19nTDJ1dTU0SktlWlF6S3AxaUc0eGJRTmQ3aWtQZ0NOa0tyMFNqdUhiUzlTREtQSEJHSmYteVpCNnhZeFlOaWZ0ZlNVcThBd1N3R3BFOGhyR19xdEdPbklWaU1LUjlFeDBKUUI4M2hBd3JIbFA0YTc4)）。

- **中国—东盟教育交流周开幕，聚焦数智教育与AI**。第19届交流周在贵州举行，已累计2.09万东盟学子留学贵州（[Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQRGVYQ0JsUklkMS10QURpd3hOMkRHN0NpRlp6TU5iSTdaNEd3cm91TjM4bWlQV0JFMGVKaFo0cGJSZ0lkeDlzQ3BQUC1lODJJSFFtOVZjaWhxclMtZXRNREM1dW5uTzJDSnlRS3dWZmJ1SGlKb3U4eUJOeTA5b1lVNnBHYkdjUXJjbThJ)），另有多条AI赋能教育的实践报道（[中国教育新闻网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE1WdFZhZjdKUkI3aF9abmtFU3IzeGlZTEx1VVFUNkdKUnJlU1JoOEZFdjFjM2h0N3FDcWMwVV94TWd3bDRkcHJIQm1DanRJMnU1ck16MnQyNzBDcDhjX1VzNy1JbzhsSU9TazBB)）。

**后续观察**：中东局势的升级可能进一步推高油价，并引发更广泛的代理战争，沙特能否保持中立将是关键变量。日本熊本地震的救援进展和建筑抗震标准再次受到审视。欧洲山火在极端高温下恐将持续数周，气候变化的直接冲击已不容忽视。文化领域，拉什迪案和莱托案分别折射出言论自由与演艺圈权力结构性弊病。
society.en:
The last 24 hours have been dominated by escalating military confrontation between the US and Iran, drawing Saudi Arabia into a widening conflict, while Japan reels from a massive earthquake that has trapped dozens in a collapsed mall and fuelled wildfires across southern Europe. Meanwhile, domestic Chinese news focuses on education reforms and AI integration, and the Zhihu community buzzes with mathematician celebrity scandals and a major hospital corruption case.

- **US-Iran conflict intensifies**: The US launched 'heavy' strikes on Iran after an attack on American troops, while Saudi Arabia struggles to stay neutral. Israeli strikes in Gaza and Lebanon continue, with dozens displaced. [US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c74gwdzywmeo) | [Saudi Arabia's dilemma](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clyx83l8jv8o) | [Israeli strikes in Gaza](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/30/israeli-strikes-leave-buildings-burning-in-gaza-city)
- **Japan earthquake aftermath**: A magnitude-7.1 quake in Kumamoto caused the collapse of a newly reopened Aeon mall, with rescuers racing to find survivors. The PM called it a 'race against time'. [Rescuers race](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNbS1IQmJkN01lNklzeTFTbDRQdkhib0gtTzk3LTY4N3VyTi1tUnVGS3NYeDZxdVNyckZTd1loYk5odU9aX203LUlxWHJaeGVsdXhjV2JGeGV6dXppbDFWMXFVSGFIOTBtWEFUanZ5Q3oyeV8wVnlaeUxRc0RHZXZHbW9ndVd3dmU5) | [Inside Aeon mall](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/30/like-volcanic-ash-falling-inside-aeon-mall-after-japans-earthquake)
- **European wildfires claim lives**: Three Greek firefighters died as gale-force winds fanned flames on Crete. France battles flare-ups in 40°C heat, with locals refusing to evacuate. [Three Greek firefighters die](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyjgwg8jddo) | [France wildfire](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c62q5we799ro)
- **Salman Rushdie attacker convicted**: Hadi Matar, 28, was found guilty of terror offences for attempting to help Hezbollah. [Rushdie attacker convicted](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c86ng1g5wy4o)
- **Jared Leto faces sexual misconduct allegations**: Four more women accuse actor of criminal sexual conduct, bringing total to ten. [Jared Leto allegations](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd7lg2nz2x2o)
- **Global markets roiled by Middle East tensions**: South Korea's Kospi fell 6% and oil prices surged as conflict spreads. [Kospi falls 6%](https://news.google.)
- **Australia takes Telegram to court** over alleged failure to remove pro-terror material. [Australia vs Telegram](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/crmrv4pnexmo)
- **China-ASEAN Education Week opens** with focus on digital and AI cooperation. [Education Week](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFBISFNIN0gyWng5WnJ3Vm9pclZZUnI0ZWhtLVM2Z2Q3UTBEVmEzRTR4SlBydWx5ZHQwWlRkYmdZM003SmxQLWN6M1FFNjNnNHRpeFNWcFNxWkR4STNDVzJjVVhXaHhtWGxad0dN)

**Watch next**: The US-Iran kinetic exchange may broaden further as Saudi Arabia faces pressure to retaliate. Japan's rescue operations will dominate headlines, while Europe's fire season is far from over. Markets will remain volatile. On the tech and society front, the Zhihu community's reaction to mathematician邓煜's Fields Medal and the hospital corruption case could fuel broader discussion on talent and governance.

military.zh:
## 军事新闻板块简报 (2026-07-30)

**导语：** 过去24小时全球军事态势急剧升温，美伊冲突从空袭扩大到伊拉克战场，中国通过向伊朗提供防空导弹及在南海部署航母编队展现战略介入能力。与此同时，美国海军签署创纪录的潜艇合同，RIMPAC演习推进无人系统实验，台海与印太方向博弈持续深化。

- **美伊冲突全面升级：** 美国以伊朗导弹袭击驻约旦美军未遂为由，联合沙特对伊拉克境内伊朗代理人发动空袭 ([NY Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxNaUMyazQ5ZUVMSWgxcHkxY0tKakNvODNlc0tvblpSQWc0Nm53NUt6WmZCUVVQY25NZjBsaEZOMW5FMm9mVUdiS2Z4aC1adEllaTZjZGh6aXJKdV81SGdabk55RC01djdXWlhMUGwtNUlOeHcxZmpTWUUtTDA0SFdlMmVsNEhXSVNOcWtMMWg0THVBWVdBM28xX3hPME02S29GV1NnVWVZRlQ4ZmVlWkJVc3FKV0FTMWR0ZWNz))，特朗普威胁进一步报复 ([NBC News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOV3JOYlFiUXFyNW54dFJ4TjN3QmoyT2xYOEdORm80bWJOQXVCUXNFa2ZOUFFseVdlRUhHSGllZUZDT29ObkM2cTNaRzVwYXlPT2l6b3J1czZwel9jZlBORUl1VVdjZXk5SV9CMG5Fd2ZVUUwzeFNLb05weWw5MnVmRVgzVF9lYWQ0bldEV0lSR1VRNWN5REpnZl9oODVVTGtqM3JadmNGVUZYTjZOalViRXMyYmRaT1k))。中国在此背景下被曝向伊朗运送防空导弹 ([AOL](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNVm03cTNFb3ZYTVBCUUNyLXAxaEhadEw4bUdNWUgyZDdhSWo5cGZ1N3RpYUc5VzVmOGdsUzE0N0ZvRk16OF9KNjdEaldlNG81U3BYblczTEU1alFuNXpYZDRMYXYwTjNrbzlFemltUS1tS3lCTFVZRmIwLXd6M2pnWQ))，使冲突具有更广泛的地缘博弈色彩。
- **中国高超音速武器部署加速：** 解放军首次在052D型驱逐舰上试射YJ-20高超音速反舰导弹 ([TWZ](https://www.twz.com/sea/china-fires-yj-20-hypersonic-anti-ship-missile-from-smaller-destroyer))，加上此前055型搭载的双锥体弹道导弹，中国海军远程打击能力正实现“下沉式”扩散。
- **南海多国对峙：** 美航母坐镇，日本陆上自卫队首次派遣至南海，中国出动航母及26艘舰船“围观” ([搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNTmFRVnNGM09BN1lRME14R2NDOFVRc3hrTzlHbU5rdE84QlE4YlhtNG03TVR0N00tSjE3c1hmM3phLXJlZ21JT0pjcmdTa0prUHlnc2Z1cFBqNmY4UmU2YXlPMDdGU2ROTXZlREM3bXZ6X282Zjk3R25LWHM0cmYycXkxSnJhVVRtcXBMUg))，台海与南海风险交织。
- **美国海军潜艇合同创纪录：** 通用动力和HII获766亿美元合同建造9艘弗吉尼亚级和5艘哥伦比亚级潜艇 ([USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/29/navy-awards-76-6b-for-9-virginia-5-columbia-subs-to-general-dynamics-hii))，反映核威慑与水下力量优先战略。
- **美台海岸警卫队首次公开联合演练：** 美海岸警卫队“米吉特”号与台湾海巡署“台北”舰共同行动 ([USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/29/u-s-reveals-coast-guard-cooperation-with-taiwan))，虽未明示地点时间，但标志美台安全合作实质性升级。
- **欧洲安全焦虑加剧：** 北约将领警告俄罗斯可能在2029年前进攻欧洲，而北约要到2035年才能就绪 ([Kyiv Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE9nUGFlZlo1aEVwQXZQQmlaaTZTRk1FVGs3WkRpYi1hN1E2X0NZQVFfMVhfakthRVZ1ZnMxV3RXRjNGSzI0Q0l6Y1N4SnpOY28))，推动多国增加国防开支。

**后续观察：** 美伊对抗已从“报复-反报复”进入多线战场阶段（伊拉克、红海、波斯湾），中国在其中的角色（武器供应、外交表态）将直接影响冲突外溢风险。南海方向，美日欧联合巡航与解放军“围观”形成新常态，需警惕意外交火。美军潜艇合同与高超音速武器扩散则提示大国技术竞赛正加速。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have witnessed a dramatic escalation in the U.S.-Iran conflict, with American forces launching airstrikes on Iranian targets in Iraq and Saudi Arabia joining the operation, while China openly defies Washington by sending anti-air missiles to Tehran. These developments, combined with fresh hypersonic missile tests from the PLA Navy and heightened South China Sea standoffs, signal a broadening theater of competition. Below are the key headlines and their deeper implications for readers tracking global military dynamics.

- **U.S.-Iran conflict erupts into direct strikes** – The U.S. military launched airstrikes on Iranian-linked targets in Iraq after foiling a missile attack on American forces. Saudi Arabia participated in the strikes, marking a significant shift in Riyadh’s posture ([U.S. launches strikes on Iranian targets](https://news.google.)). This overt intervention risks drawing Iraq back into a regional war ([Iraq once again becomes a battlefield](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZkFVX3lxTE8tX1pONi1VZFRQTVdMSE5ZTjRDalJoOHdueXJFWTNvR1RCM0lOb0Q4OVdkTnZIOGpHTElWQ1FlcTRUS29SSjdiMWRzcU1IMUNIVHYxUXRkWWxQSE5ySndFOHJhSjRZdw)).

- **China sends anti-air missiles to Iran despite Trump-Xi ties** – Beijing is reportedly shipping anti-air missiles to Tehran, a direct challenge to U.S. efforts to isolate Iran ([China sending anti-air missiles to Iran](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNVm03cTNFb3ZYTVBCUUNyLXAxaEhadEw4bUdNWUgyZDdhSWo5cGZ1N3RpYUc5VzVmOGdsUzE0N0ZvRk16OF9KNjdEaldlNG81U3BYblczTEU1alFuNXpYZDRMYXYwTjNrbzlFemltUS1tS3lCTFVZRmIwLXd6M2pnWQ)). This move undermines U.S. coercive diplomacy and signals Chinese alignment with the anti-U.S. axis.

- **PLA tests hypersonic YJ-20 from smaller destroyer** – New footage confirms China has integrated the YJ-20 hypersonic anti-ship missile onto Type 052D destroyers, not just the larger Type 055. This sharply expands the range of platforms able to strike high-value naval assets ([China Fires YJ-20 Hypersonic Anti-Ship Missile](https://www.twz.com/sea/china-fires-yj-20-hypersonic-anti-ship-missile-from-smaller-destroyer)).

- **South China Sea standoff: 26 Chinese ships monitor U.S./Japan/EU drills** – A U.S. carrier-led flotilla from Japan and Europe entered disputed waters, prompting a heavy PLA response with 26 vessels. This is the largest shadowing operation since 2016 and raises the risk of accidental clash ([26艘中国舰船“强势围观”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNTmFRVnNGM09BN1lRME14R2NDOFVRc3hrTzlHbU5rdE84QlE4YlhtNG03TVR0N00tSjE3c1hmM3phLXJlZ21JT0pjcmdTa0prUHlnc2Z1cFBqNmY4UmU2YXlPMDdGU2ROTXZlREM3bXZ6X282Zjk3R25LWHM0cmYycXkxSnJhVVRtcXBMUg)).

- **U.S. Navy awards $76.6B for 14 submarines** – After a three-year delay, General Dynamics and HII won contracts for nine Virginia-class and five Columbia-class subs, a critical boost to the nuclear shipbuilding industrial base ([Navy Awards $76.6B for 9 Virginia, 5 Columbia Subs](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/29/navy-awards-76-6b-for-9-virginia-5-columbia-subs-to-general-dynamics-hii)).

- **NATO warns Russia may attack Europe by 2029** – Alliance generals assess that Russia could be ready for conventional war against NATO within three years, while NATO force improvements lag until 2035, creating a dangerous readiness gap ([Alliance Generals: Russia May Attack Europe by 2029](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE9nUGFlZlo1aEVwQXZQQmlaaTZTRk1FVGs3WkRpYi1hN1E2X0NZQVFfMVhfakthRVZ1ZnMxV3RXRjNGSzI0Q0l6Y1N4SnpOY28)).

- **Ukraine and NATO launch drone countermeasure fund** – The Brave1 initiative is funding five priority areas including active protection and electromagnetic attack, reflecting the evolution of the drone war in Ukraine ([Ukraine, NATO launch new funding program](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/ukraine-nato-launch-new-funding-program-to-counter-russian-drones/)).

- **Houthis consider tolling Bab al-Mandeb Strait** – The Iran-backed group is reportedly mulling charging passage fees through the chokepoint, a move that would escalate maritime economic warfare ([Trump Vows Revenge](https://www.twz.com/news-features/trump-vows-revenge-for-iranian-missile-attack-u-s-and-saudis-join-forces-to-strike-iraq)).

**Watch next:** The U.S.-Iran crisis is entering a new direct kinetic phase, which could trigger a wider confrontation involving Iraq, Saudi Arabia, and proxy forces. Simultaneously, China’s hypersonic missile expansion and South China Sea assertiveness will test U.S.-China crisis management. The NATO readiness warning adds urgency to European defense investment. Readers should monitor the next 48 hours for possible Iranian retaliation or further U.S. strikes.

tech.zh:
今日科技板块呈现多线交织态势：AI领域巨头竞争白热化，微软与OpenAI/Anthropic关系微妙，Zuckerberg描绘个人AI代理蓝图；汽车行业电动化加速，Ferrari首款EV售罄，Hyundai IONIQ 3震撼定价；政策层面美国扩大机器人禁令至扫地机器人，xAI起诉明尼苏达州反裸体化应用法；经典软件Winamp借Deezer重生。

- [微软从Anthropic投资获利32亿美元，同时与OpenAI关系复杂，并宣布Copilot超级应用](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/29/microsoft-logs-3-2b-from-anthropic-investment-but-openai-was-a-mixed-bag/)，AI格局重塑。
- [Qualcomm宣布9月1日起处理器全线涨价](https://www.theverge.com/tech/972894/qualcomm-price-hikes-q2-2026-earnings)，叠加RAM成本上涨，下一代手机将更贵。
- [美国FCC机器人禁令意外涵盖扫地机器人](https://www.theverge.com/policy/972312/us-robot-ban-sweep-up-chinese-vacuums)，引发智能家居行业震动。
- [Ferrari首款EV Luce售价64万美元，2026年产量500台已售罄](https://electrek.co/2026/07/29/ferrari-luce-ev-sold-out-2026-allocation/)，证明超豪华电动市场可行。
- [Hyundai IONIQ 3起售价3万美元，续航超300英里，预订兴趣创历史新高](https://electrek.co/2026/07/29/hyundai-reveals-ioniq-3-prices-start-30000-interest-surges/)，威胁Model 3。
- [后量子密码算法HAWK被Mythos攻击发现致命弱点](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/mythos-uncovers-crypto-weaknesses-that-went-unknown-for-years/)，PQC标准化进程受挫。
- [Winamp与Deezer合作推出新播放器](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/29/winamp-aims-for-a-comeback-with-a-new-music-player-powered-by-deezer/)，怀旧品牌能否在流媒体时代突围？
- [Hacker News上Vision Pro的“最酷用途”获471分](https://christianselig.com/2026/07/vision-pro-house/)，用户分享用Vision Pro看房，展示空间计算新场景。

**后续观察：** AI投资泡沫（韩国案例）、政策监管收紧（机器人禁令、AI监管）与硬件涨价周期，将影响下半年科技行业走势。
tech.en:
This morning's tech landscape is shaped by aggressive AI monetization pushes, a sweeping US robot import ban, and contrasting fortunes in electric vehicles. Qualcomm is raising chip prices, the FCC's ban now explicitly covers robot vacuums, and Ferrari's first EV sold out its 2026 allocation in weeks. Meanwhile, Microsoft and Meta are openly competing with OpenAI and Anthropic, and South Korea's AI bubble appears to have burst. In the developer community, a Vision Pro housing hack (ironically) and reflections on productivity dominate discussions.

- **Qualcomm's price hike** hits smartphone processors starting Sept 1, compounding memory cost increases. [Source](https://www.theverge.com/tech/972894/qualcomm-price-hikes-q2-2026-earnings)
- **FCC's robot ban** sweeps up robot vacuums, not just humanoids, as US government extends restrictions to Chinese-made advanced robotics. [Source](https://www.theverge.com/policy/972312/us-robot-ban-sweep-up-chinese-vacuums) | [Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2226533/the-us-government-robot-ban-also-includes-vacuums/)
- **Ferrari Luce EV** sells out ~500 units for 2026 in less than two months, defying design criticism. [Source](https://electrek.co/2026/07/29/ferrari-luce-ev-sold-out-2026-allocation/)
- **Microsoft reports $3.2B profit** from Anthropic investment, while OpenAI results are mixed; the company confirms a Copilot super app launching this year. [Source](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/29/microsoft-logs-3-2b-from-anthropic-investment-but-openai-was-a-mixed-bag/) | [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/972927/microsoft-copilot-super-app-confirmed)
- **Zuckerberg predicts** billions will have personal AI agents within five years as Meta bets heavily on enterprise AI. [Source](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/29/mark-zuckerberg-predicts-that-billions-of-people-will-have-personal-ai-agents-in-five-years/)
- **South Korea's AI bubble** appears to have popped, with multiple video analyses and discussions on Hacker News. [Source](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hy90LdpEUvQ) | [Source 2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qeXpUZTdvsI)
- **Post-quantum cryptography candidate HAWK** is knocked out by a new Mythos attack that reveals years-hidden weaknesses. [Source](https://arstechnica.com/security/2026/07/mythos-uncovers-crypto-weaknesses-that-went-unknown-for-years/)

**Watch next:** Monitor the fallout from the FCC robot ban on consumer robotics, Ford's 2028 robotaxi plans against Tesla's rival efforts, and the solid-state battery alliance between SK On and Factorial Energy. In AI, the US considering a FINRA-style watchdog for top models could reshape regulation.
