- [前深圳外援阿利兹·约翰逊接近加盟巴黎篮球俱乐部](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPQjdFUTBWcmdKNXZlZGJGVXZGd1JpTXJhNGVEM1h6el9BTnFzb0hDVlZETU1pU0xKU015MFJRb2NPejltUnNMUkUwM2d5Q2trTzlVRWsxcE9tOFhZdGlIZnBTWnB2N3B4eXVwaTNGUXhZcGRBV0dYY2pUS29kWGtCNDcyRWw0S1VvY0JFQQ)
- [KT 2-0 T1，BDD合砍13/4/18获POM](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE8xbURfWi05dkpSd2lxSXRRM1FmUVFpVkJ0cnFPT3dzWHAzR2JZWVdySFVVczNRa2pwRDZpcXFjdkZWTTNXdjc4ZHpxbHhRR1g4MjNsMlRxaC1HdC1aMEhJak8tOA)
- [曹芷豪专访：希望成为赵睿那样的后卫](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE5SYjhBSDBmbkpEZHRnQnUxNC1YZTl2NFQzejRtZzROMHBXS3EybXVOUjYxNHJGbF9EdER3amtPNTR6YTd6RktvOElLQjR6cWMtLWY5OXRCdnd3QUsyVDdIX2Zsb3c4WWhRTElkYXF4cw)

**后续观察**：利物浦股权谈判结果将直接影响夏窗转会预算；FIFA对阿根廷的处罚决定预计数周内出炉，可能影响2028年世界杯预选赛备战；CBA选秀新规落地后大学生球员择业路径将更清晰；T1若继续连败，LCK季后赛席位堪忧。
sports.en:
Today's sports landscape is dominated by the Commonwealth Games in Glasgow, a deepening cricket cheating scandal, and major football governance controversies. Meanwhile, Chinese basketball undergoes structural changes and the esports community reacts to LCK upsets.

- **Commonwealth Games highlights**: Scottish swimmer [Angharad Evans](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/articles/cp9e024ypkno) wins breaststroke gold, Northern Ireland's [Kate O'Connor](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/athletics/articles/c98vje167g7o) claims heptathlon gold, and England's netball team [crushes Tonga 94-32](https://www.skysports.com/netball/news/12040/13568214/commonwealth-games-england-dominate-tonga-in-must-win-contest-as-quest-for-semi-final-spot-continues).
- **Cricket scandal escalates**: The Saltburn 'Clicky Ponting' affair sees player [suspended](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cricket/articles/cg7m5grrp7ko) as the club concedes the next match; [analysis](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cricket/articles/c980w3wd370o) highlights the wicketkeeper's crucial role. Meanwhile, Sir Garfield Sobers is [honored at his state funeral](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cricket/articles/c87n3d4rj2vo) and Stephen Fleming is [expected](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cricket/articles/c5yvp474rpro) to become England Test coach.
- **Football governance and club news**: FIFA opens [disciplinary proceedings](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cp3rkwgy6y7o) against Argentina for post-World Cup behavior and a Falklands banner. Liverpool CEO Billy Hogan [discusses](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c8xnvqrxv8ro) FSG's transition and investment. Gianni Infantino's plan to [sell World Cup stakes](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cjejl274xx8o) draws scrutiny.
- **Darts and boxing**: Luke Littler's [dominance](https://www.skysports.com/darts/news/12040/13568177/luke-littler-edges-scottie-scheffler-and-jannik-sinner-as-the-most-dominant-sportsperson-love-the-darts-podcast) questioned as most dominant sportsperson; Sebastian Bialecki wins [Players Championship 26](https://www.skysports.com/darts/news/12040/13568167/players-championship-26-sebastian-bialecki-claims-second-pdc-ranking-title-as-henry-coates-and-beau-greaves-shine). Ugandan boxer Aziz Abdul, grandson of Idi Amin, [disqualified](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/boxing/articles/czxewy7zl46o) for headbutt at Commonwealth Games.
- **Chinese basketball shifts**: New CBA rules require college players to [enter the draft](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxPTFM5ZlpTTWtZaG0wM095MGU3M1kydnJnaWh4VjNrazlHaG5DXzBLckI4eVlGSXRWdTNQUDZrUllZTjJxaE9ETl8wbjFkbVZtZG1PMy1UNGIzTlY3RXJSN0xlRGhSZGpzZDdXV3lKSUlKSzE3Qm9FeEk2LURvZFppTUZ3VzVYaDlTYV9IV1pHeGpyUUY1ak9R) before NBL. Former NBA player Alize Johnson [joins Paris Basketball](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPQjdFUTBWcmdKNXZlZGJGVXZGd1JpTXJhNGVEM1h6el9BTnFzb0hDVlZETU1pU0xKU015MFJRb2NPejltUnNMUkUwM2d5Q2trTzlVRWsxcE9tOFhZdGlIZnBTWnB2N3B4eXVwaTNGUXhZcGRBV0dYY2pUS29kWGtCNDcyRWw0S1VvY0JFQQ). Greg Oden [recalls](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNdkZRSXJaXzZ2aUFrYlZNQjk2bDd0eXJEMzVHZGwyNUExOGpHQm8wcUViNDNrMllCMFhXQVN5cXRNZUtWaUtCWkpWRkVLbVdIenFmMS1hXzBzbEFDM0hhRU5acDM0ZGtJQ21yR3o1QWRSV2pFZ3JzZE4xU2Q2UHpPUnlR) earning $1M in six months in CBA.
- **Esports community frenzy**: LCK sees KT Rolster [defeat T1](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5aMjhpOVBHYklnaGhUaTJMQVlYZ3k5TU5rOE4zNUNEdUZTZjQ2Tm41QV9NY1lna3NFemVUWlMyTEI4ak9KdW9PZEY1MHdVU2JtR0swamVJTkJWclVpd1ZXU1pQbw) for the second time in a row, sparking fan outrage and calls for roster changes. BLG [beats LGD](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMif0FVX3lxTFBvNHNidGNPYlRGZ3I3dFVRVUI3V1BySnlfN0xERFZYQjlLT2JIV1paejd6ZUdTOGZ3c2RpRy1CTTZ3c2Y0QjFpbG10SktzS3FGZmhvSWpiWjV6R1hrekZFa2o5OHpzX0xrTFlmQWcyc2JxaU1qUUtSWkYwLXBJdzA) in LPL. Steve Kerr [addresses](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE9kN2RheTNHbWxmNHZmeV9pS0VEU1JFeS1JNC1fZ2hIakFXb1NQUEhwTXRldVJPMUlkUENrdG82bTJxb1hIalI0TkMyVzNyRmpXQ29XX2Fkbl9QcEYtX0VNMWJmbw) Warriors-James trade rumors.

**Watch next**: Keep an eye on the fallout from the Saltburn investigation, the Commonwealth Games medal race, the CBA draft rule implementation, and the LCK/LPL playoff implications as the season heats up.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐头条由BTS与格莱美的对峙引爆——防弹少年团宣布不参与2027年格莱美奖申报，以抗议新设“最佳亚洲流行表演”奖项，格莱美CEO Harvey Mason Jr.公开回应表示“伤心”但仍坚持该奖项“绝非分裂”[1](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bts-grammys-arirang-wont-submit-2027-awards-ceo-responds-1235600777/)[2](https://deadline.com/2026/07/grammy-ceo-saddened-bts-withdrawal-defends-asian-pop-1237012911/)。与此同时，欧美票房迎来《蜘蛛侠：崭新一日》开画，目标冲击2026年最高首周纪录，Tom Holland透露早期剪辑版曾“令人讨厌”[3](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-spider-man-brand-new-day-cut-he-hated-1237012949/)。中国方面，微短剧产业领军人物王海歌被推至聚光灯下[4](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBCd1JpNjB6cURZT1pmdVdxenA4N1RVQzJjMGkxM3oyNjZic1RZU1EyZnR5NDl5T3Q3TllycEExb3RNS3hnMk4tZFZFRVJNclpFMjZCd2JHWG0xV3dwbWc)，而微博社区则因“苏新皓全场红热搜”和“张泽禹被逼道歉”两起事件持续发酵[5](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE1GT3podlN2dWE0aGNTcUxfbXhVQ2xaSEttWUw3M0VZZWNRRkM3ZjNmM3BIeFI5Y3BYRl9Nd25seU1SdDh3OC1LWnk1eWRlbU5vRVplc1BiVG5aeUVZV19rdEpfRlpXNGFzSVg0V0lrdlA)[6](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE1ZU0ZCZ09jWkg2aTcwd0tKZlp0NjI1NXZjdFVOdnNObTFYc1oyR2xyWFEwTlNTcW5xaGg5YnNaSDVJaGh4X0V3Z3hfalVESVFmTmR6SF9COWYyTlFLN2daUXlzeFhCekNteFpfNkNlZ1ByWGo2a2lHUkhRbXZ0QQ)。日韩方面，fromis_9宣布亚洲巡演，ILLIT与LE SSERAFIM获日本白金认证[7](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858421wpp/illit-and-le-sserafim-earn-riaj-platinum-certifications-for-streaming-in-japan)。

后续观察：BTS与格莱美的博弈可能重塑亚洲音乐人在国际奖项中的策略，格莱美新设分类的争议远未结束；《蜘蛛侠》票房表现将检验“超级英雄疲劳”是否真正被打破；微博上年轻偶像的舆论危机频发，反映出粉丝文化与公众道德期待之间的张力持续升级。
entertainment.en:
The entertainment landscape today is dominated by a major industry rift as BTS boycotts the 2027 Grammys over the new Asian Pop category, while Tom Holland's 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' aims for a record-breaking box office weekend. In a cultural firestorm, author Joyce Carol Oates defended Christopher Nolan's 'The Odyssey' against a scathing translator review, and Ben Affleck won $1M for charity on 'Who Wants to Be a Millionaire.' Meanwhile, K-pop crossovers and Korean content expansion signal shifting global dynamics.

- **Grammys vs. BTS: A Crossroads for Asian Representation**: BTS announced they will not submit for the 2027 Grammys, protesting the new 'Best Asian Pop Music Performance' category as divisive. Grammy CEO Harvey Mason Jr. expressed being 'saddened' but defended the category as 'never to divide' ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/grammy-ceo-saddened-bts-withdrawal-defends-asian-pop-1237012911/), [Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bts-grammys-arirang-wont-submit-2027-awards-ceo-responds-1235600777/)). This moves beyond a single award to questions about how Western institutions recognize non-Western music.
- **Spider-Man Aims to Break 2026's Box Office Ceiling**: Sony's 'Spider-Man: Brand New Day' targets the year's biggest opening, with analysts calling it a 'gold standard' for superhero relevance ([The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/spider-man-brand-new-day-box-office-opening-tom-holland-1236659734/)). Tom Holland revealed he 'hated' an early cut of the film, underscoring the creative struggles behind blockbuster success ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-spider-man-brand-new-day-cut-he-hated-1237012949/)).
- **Literary Feud: Joyce Carol Oates vs. Translator Emily Wilson**: Oates slammed Wilson's viral review of Nolan's 'The Odyssey' as 'crude language of MAGA folks,' igniting a debate over scholarly critique versus cultural gatekeeping ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/joyce-carol-oates-the-odyssey-slams-translator-review-1236823922/)). The clash highlights tensions between classicists and popular filmmakers.
- **Ben Affleck's Charity Million**: Affleck, alongside Jeopardy champ Jamie Ding, won $1M on 'Who Wants to Be a Millionaire' for his Eastern Congo Initiative, following Matt Damon's win last year ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/ben-affleck-wins-1-million-who-wants-to-be-a-millionaire-1236823747/)). Celebrity game show philanthropy continues to drive major donations.
- **Disney+ Korea Doubles Down on Fortune-Telling Reality**: After 'Battle of Fates' became Disney+ Korea's biggest series premiere, a spinoff 'House of Fates' has been greenlit, sending guests on spiritual pilgrimages ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/disney-plus-korea-battle-of-fates-spin-off-house-of-fates-1237006528/), [The Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/tv/tv-news/disney-greenlights-house-of-fates-spinoff-korean-battle-of-fates-1236659761/)). This signals streaming platforms' appetite for localized, supernatural content.
- **K-Pop Crossover: Tame Impala & Jennie Perform 'Dracula' Live**: For the first time, the Australian band and BLACKPINK's Jennie performed their hit together in Boston, marking a significant moment in Western-K-pop collaboration ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/tame-impala-jennie-perform-dracula-boston-1235597315/)).
- **Chinese Entertainment Trends: Micro-Short Dramas and Market Inflows**: Wang Haige is highlighted as a pioneer in China's micro-short drama sector ([中华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBCd1JpNjB6cURZT1pmdVdxenA4N1RVQzJjMGkxM3oyNjZic1RZU1EyZnR5NDl5T3Q3TllycEExb3RNS3hnMk4tZFZFRVJNclpFMjZCd2JHWG0xV3dwbWc)), while foreign capital is pouring into Chinese entertainment companies, per Sina Finance ([新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1aZ3kwaV84VllmQkVIY0FxWWhYVTJJYVVNQkt6SlFlbUtLYURrVnozdXlNTkhiWm5WODJXSjBIOHltckpfUGltOEJVbXZfMm9DRmwtclRwVldKTHpWWjNDYmtqSXRuMl90b3pEQmRoTTZJQQ)).
- **Weibo Drama: Su Xinhao's Concert Fans Chant for 'Hot Search' and Zhang Zeyu Apology Controversy**: Su Xinhao's concert fans orchestrated a 'full red' trending topic, while Zhang Zeyu faced backlash with 'victim-blaming' discourse ([微博社区动态](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE1ZU0ZCZ09jWkg2aTcwd0tKZlp0NjI1NXZjdFVOdnNObTFYc1oyR2xyWFEwTlNTcW5xaGg5YnNaSDVJaGh4X0V3Z3hfalVESVFmTmR6SF9COWYyTlFLN2daUXlzeFhCekNteFpfNkNlZ1ByWGo2a2lHUkhRbXZ0QQ)). These stories reveal the power of organized fanbases and the rapid spread of online discourse.

**Watch next**: The BTS-Grammys fallout will likely dominate music industry conversations, especially if other Asian artists follow suit. Spider-Man's opening weekend numbers will be closely tracked as a bellwether for superhero fatigue. On the Chinese front, the micro-short drama regulation and foreign investment trends bear watching. Weibo's trending mechanisms continue to shape celebrity narratives, with potential for regulatory scrutiny.

美股.zh: 美伊冲突骤然升级，美国对伊朗发动空袭，油价飙升，避险情绪推高国债价格。与此同时，微软财报超预期并宣布加大资本开支，股价大涨8%，提振科技板块信心。FOMC维持利率不变，但长期收益率走高，市场开始质疑主席Warsh的抗通胀信誉。AI军备竞赛持续，**[Zuckerberg](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/zuckerberg-metas-ai-capacity-dilemma-what-to-sell-vs-what-to-keep.html)** 在Meta财报中透露AI算力分配困境，而**[SpaceX](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/spacex-memphis-ai-data-centers-face-house-energy-committee-demands.html)** 被众议院能源委员会要求公开AI数据中心记录。此外，美国正推动亚洲采用其AI，但**[中国凭借廉价模型占据优势](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/us-wants-asia-to-use-its-ai-but-china-dominates-cheaper-models.html)**。短期看，地缘风险与科技财报博弈将主导美股波动。
美股.en:
US equities ended a turbulent session mixed, as the outbreak of US-Iran military strikes sent crude soaring and weighed on cyclical sectors, but a powerful rally in Microsoft shares on stellar earnings provided a stark counterbalance. The Federal Reserve held rates steady but faced renewed credibility questions after long-term Treasury yields jumped, and the Senate postponed a key AG nomination vote amid tensions over IRS audits. 

- **US strikes Iran**: Military action against Iran after a missile attack reignited open conflict, sending oil prices higher and raising risks for global supply chains and inflation ([US strikes Iran](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/us-iran-war-hormuz-centcom-trump-.html)).
- **Microsoft jumps 8%**: The company boosted capital spending plans citing AI demand, and changed accounting for data centers to signal positive free cash flow ([Microsoft earnings](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/microsoft-msft-q4-earnings-report-2026.html)).
- **Fed leaves rates unchanged**: The FOMC statement disappointed markets that had hoped for a more hawkish tone, and long-term yields rose as Chairman Warsh's inflation-fighting credibility came into question ([Fed credibility](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/29/kevin-warsh-fed-treasury-yields-inflation-credibility-interest-rates.html)).
- **Samsung beats estimates**: Q2 operating profit topped expectations on soaring AI chip demand, extending its record run ([Samsung earnings](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/samsung-q2-earnings-ai-chip-.html)).
- **China threatens retaliation**: Beijing condemned the US humanoid robot ban as 'severely damaging' ties and vowed countermeasures, adding a new layer of tech trade tension ([China robot ban](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/07/30/china-us-robot-humanoid-ban-trump-visit.html)).

**Signal**: The market is pricing a sharp divergence between AI winners and geopolitical losers; next week's Fed commentary and Iran developments will determine whether the tech rally can sustain itself amid macro headwinds.

欧洲经济.zh: 欧洲股市受美伊冲突拖累收盘走低，油价攀升加剧通胀忧虑。欧央行最新工资跟踪器显示Q1 2027谈判工资增速2.7%，暗示薪资压力稳定，但**[Morningstar分析](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxQMTVsc09UelEyZEpja19WcExTTmt2aFFmQ2gyd0wwSHZ2a3ZYRFdLOG9NMTR2X09CLW0yYzZoRVBDc1Zhc0M5NlI3WTFIMHhISzNzdVJ2TzYtTXFuSTFNZjdrdm1EQ21uLVlUYWdRSTAwSWVYbGRzYXZSRl84TGowc0pRUDRYNDdySGlRWTVMX0c1VHk2ckJ1ZjcxVlRkb2F3by16c2pFanAxazNMSUoxd1d0dTVxS0ZZenhR)** 质疑高能源价格是否迫使欧央行加息。宝马宣布**[裁员8000人](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/29/bmw-cut-jobs-germany-pressure-chinese-rivals)**，主因中国竞争对手压力，显示欧洲汽车业困境。正面消息是**[爱尔兰经济恢复增长](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxNQkRBOHkyTHRvWlpYR0ZicXZLLUlsM1czUjEyWThVVF9GVjl6M3d0cVk3UmdRMGR6Nlk2QnBLdldJNkIxQ1h1dW9pUHl0MUk1UzJUbzNWa1dmXzNxbXFnd3JESjdQbXd5LUxoNzNHNTdlZWxhWUFYU3lGY09tVEtUc0lXSWNTT2tlcVV6cHQxM0lkT1BlMUVxZXlRQ1QzVDcy)**，提振欧元区信心。欧洲经济面临能源成本、外部竞争与货币政策的三重考验。
欧洲经济.en:
European stocks closed mostly lower as escalating US-Iran tensions pushed oil prices higher and raised stagflation fears. The ECB's latest wage tracker showed stable negotiated wage growth at 2.7%, but analysts now question whether the central bank can avoid raising rates if energy prices keep climbing. BMW's announcement of up to 8,000 job cuts underlines the existential threat Chinese EV and tech rivals pose to legacy European industry.

- **Stocks lower on geopolitical risk**: European indices fell as the US-Iran conflict intensified, with oil prices climbing again after Iran rejected an Omani proposal on the Strait of Hormuz ([European markets wrap](https://news.google.)).
- **ECB wage tracker at 2.7%**: Q1 2027 data shows stable negotiated wage pressures, providing some comfort but not enough to offset energy-driven inflation risks ([ECB wage](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/pr/date/2026/html/ecb.pr260729~4ad7508d8a.en.html)).
- **BMW to cut 'as many as 8,000 jobs'**: The German automaker's voluntary redundancy program targets admin and development roles, directly attributing pressure to Chinese rivals ([BMW cuts](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jul/29/bmw-cut-jobs-germany-pressure-chinese-rivals)).
- **Irish economy returns to growth**: GDP rebounded, boosting Eurozone growth hopes and offering a counterpoint to broader weakness ([Irish growth](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMioAFBVV95cUxNQkRBOHkyTHRvWlpYR0ZicXZLLUlsM1czUjEyWThVVF9GVjl6M3d0cVk3UmdRMGR6Nlk2QnBLdldJNkIxQ1h1dW9pUHl0MUk1UzJUbzNWa1dmXzNxbXFnd3JESjdQbXd5LUxoNzNHNTdlZWxhWUFYU3lGY09tVEtUc0lXSWNTT2tlcVV6cHQxM0lkT1BlMUVxZXlRQ1QzVDcy)).
- **Eurozone inflation outlook**: Rising energy prices from the Iran conflict could force the ECB to raise rates, complicating the growth outlook ([Inflation outlook](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxQMTVsc09UelEyZEpja19WcExTTmt2aFFmQ2gyd0wwSHZ2a3ZYRFdLOG9NMTR2X09CLW0yYzZoRVBDc1Zhc0M5NlI3WTFIMHhISzNzdVJ2TzYtTXFuSTFNZjdrdm1EQ21uLVlUYWdRSTAwSWVYbGRzYXZSRl84TGowc0pRUDRYNDdySGlRWTVMX0c1VHk2ckJ1ZjcxVlRkb2F3by16c2pFanAxazNMSUoxd1d0dTVxS0ZZenhR)).

**Signal**: Europe’s industrial heartland is squeezed between rising energy costs from the Middle East and fierce Chinese competition, making the ECB’s monetary policy path increasingly uncertain.

中国经济.zh: 今日A股在“韩流”冲击下企稳，科创50指数一度跌超6%，但宽基ETF放量护盘。中际旭创港股首日破发，反映全球AI情绪转冷，但其背后是**[长鑫存储IPO](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3362256/cxmt-shock-how-chinas-viable-alternatives-punch-nvidia-micron-sk-hynix-shares)** 带来的替代预期——中国DRAM产能崛起正在重塑全球半导体格局。与此同时，**[MLCC企业](https://www.scmp.com/tech/tech-trends/article/3362265/chinese-mlcc-firms-profits-and-stock-prices-fatten-hunger-electronic-rice)** 利润大涨，显示AI基础设施仍为中国电子产业链提供支撑。央行开展**[2705亿+6000亿逆回购](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBPTFVfMGkxTEJETDc4U0lDejJzdXVyRks1ZFdXbVRRUEZXVUw5X28wYUlBVTd1STFxekxNc0xEUFpBRTY3NU5WZmRuZlozZk4wWWppNGhuR1NKWVJGNWc)** 维护流动性。香港方面，**[CMU链接瑞士西班牙](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362286/hong-kong-expands-cmus-global-reach-swiss-spanish-securities-link)** 扩大国际互联。短期看，中国股市受外部波动影响，但政策托底与国产替代逻辑仍提供韧性。
中国经济.en:
Chinese markets showed resilience amid the global AI sell-off, with the broader market rising as ETF inflows provided support, but AI-related names like Zhongji Innolight struggled on debut. The semiconductor self-sufficiency narrative gained traction with CXMT’s $9.8 billion IPO and surging profits for MLCC makers. Hong Kong faced contagion from South Korea’s tech rout, prompting regulator intervention.

- **Zhongji Innolight debuts lower**: The optical transceiver maker fell up to 3% on Hong Kong's biggest share sale of 2026, caught in the global AI demand downturn ([Innolight falls](https://www.scmp.com/business/companies/article/3362321/zhongji-innolight-shares-fall-hong-kong-debut-amid-global-ai-sell)).
- **CXMT shock challenges incumbents**: ChangXin Memory Technologies’ massive Shanghai IPO underscores China’s push into DRAM, threatening Nvidia, Micron, and SK Hynix ([CXMT shock](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3362256/cxmt-shock-how-chinas-viable-alternatives-punch-nvidia-micron-sk-hynix-shares)).
- **MLCC makers profit surge**: Chinese manufacturers of multilayer ceramic capacitors see explosive first-half earnings driven by AI infrastructure demand ([MLCC profits](https://www.scmp.com/tech/tech-trends/article/3362265/chinese-mlcc-firms-profits-and-stock-prices-fatten-hunger-electronic-rice)).
- **Hong Kong hit by Korea tech rout**: Sharp swings in Samsung and SK Hynix reverberated in Hong Kong, leading to regulatory scrutiny of leveraged products and fund embezzlement cases ([HK-Korea contagion](https://www.scmp.com/business/markets/article/3362300/how-south-koreas-tech-rout-hit-hong-kong-and-why-regulators-stepped)).
- **HK expands CMU global reach**: The HKMA linked its settlement platform with Switzerland’s SIX, giving access to Swiss and Spanish securities ([CMU expansion](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3362286/hong-kong-expands-cmus-global-reach-swiss-spanish-securities-link)).

**Signal**: China’s AI hardware ecosystem is deepening, but near-term sentiment remains hostage to global tech volatility; state-backed ETF inflows and policy support are cushioning the downside.

同花顺社区动态.zh: 今日同花顺社区热度集中在资金面与避险资产。央行开展大规模逆回购（2705亿7天+6000亿隔夜）释放维稳信号，引发讨论。金饰价格突破1239元/克，投资者关注黄金避险价值。昨日ETF资金整体净流入423.59亿元，融资买入个股中中际旭创以61.13亿元居首，显示主力资金对AI龙头的分歧。此外，**[东吴证券给予纽威股份买入评级](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5lUDNZRk5Fb0s2ZlVUa0U3aENkTklxb0FmV0tHN0R6NGY3aVRRN3RPRHltRHZCVHJHa0loY3YtZkg2cWxGVGhaMGh2d1Y3Q1JHWE0xbUNMbE1TUGJkSjZVTUJB)**，以及富春染织摘地等产业新闻。社区情绪整体偏谨慎，但政策护盘信号下部分投资者寻求结构性机会。
同花顺社区动态.en:
Retail investor sentiment in China showed cautious optimism as the PBoC injected significant liquidity via reverse repos and gold prices hit new highs above 1,239 yuan/gram. ETF inflows surged to 423.59 billion yuan yesterday, indicating institutional and possibly state-backed buying. Corporate expansions and analyst upgrades also featured prominently.

- **PBoC injects liquidity**: The central bank conducted 270.5 billion yuan in 7-day reverse repos and 600 billion yuan in overnight repos to ease funding conditions ([PBoC ops](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBPTFVfMGkxTEJETDc4U0lDejJzdXVyRks1ZFdXbVRRUEZXVUw5X28wYUlBVTd1STFxekxNc0xEUFpBRTY3NU5WZmRuZlozZk4wWWppNGhuR1NKWVJGNWc)).
- **Gold prices rally**: Domestic gold jewelry prices rose to as high as 1,239 yuan/gram, reflecting safe-haven demand amid geopolitical tensions ([Gold up](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBiV0ZHLW1wUUNfWWVkZU53ZmdneTFxMDZlXzJ6TkFvVXFPNm12TVVURnN1bGcwRE9iM25DaUtQeXdEcThzVUhKWTNKb1VCZEhELS1JZ0ZhZlkxeVhGekE)).
- **ETF net inflows hit 423.59 billion yuan** on July 29, signaling strong capital support for equities amid market volatility ([ETF inflows](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBUVEpBNGJqZkg1WE1Qdl91WEl0VXY3NnpfZko4Vmd2ZGVwZWhZMy1sT3lyckJBY2lGS3N1bWRfVzhkbEdxYTZfVUtpVzlFbzFTa3AxNThHck53eWJjdHc)).
- **Major stock rating**: Dongwu Securities issued a 'buy' rating for Neway Valve (纽威股份), highlighting industrial opportunities ([Rating](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE5lUDNZRk5Fb0s2ZlVUa0U3aENkTklxb0FmV0tHN0R6NGY3aVRRN3RPRHltRHZCVHJHa0loY3YtZkg2cWxGVGhaMGh2d1Y3Q1JHWE0xbUNMbE1TUGJkSjZVTUJB)).
- **Corporate expansions**: Unisplendour (紫光) established a manufacturing company in Hainan, and Fuchun Dyeing & Weaving secured land in Hangzhou for a new materials project ([Unisplendour](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTE9mYnVMRUpIanQzTE1ZQnRRWEc1NDlQLVNWZjZWMUlheUtFekh4ME9hSnNtdEU1VEY5NnNYY0tUYjJ1YzhvZkhQbG5uOERkdDEtd2NwQ3VzR1hTMm9ZZjNLNU1R), [Fuchun](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBLU3JmYkJaQlpFZ1dUbGQ3VUI2aGZUbmFIaHFsWWlJcUE5WGhmNlptNzdsQ3BwNnI0ODVmNFdEYVNyNk51ME1tRVp2YUtJZUQtdFBHMENNaGNROU9sd2hfSU9R)).

**Signal**: Retail and institutional capital are flowing into Chinese equities as a geopolitical haven, supported by PBoC easing and gold demand; watch for continued ETF buying as a key sentiment anchor.

欧美.zh:
中东战火急遽升温，美国与伊朗直接交火，沙特被迫选边；欧洲则面临山火与司法裁决并行。

- **美伊冲突：打击与反打击循环**。美国对伊朗发动“重型”打击，回应伊朗周二对美军的导弹攻击（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c74gwdzywmeo)）。沙特阿拉伯陷入两难——既需威慑也需降温（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clyx83l8jv8o)）。美沙联合空袭伊拉克境内伊朗民兵（[NPR](https://www.npr.org/2026/07/29/nx-s1-5911806)）。加沙及黎巴嫩南部同步遭以军打击（[半岛](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/30/israeli-strikes-leave-buildings-burning-in-gaza-city)），五个月冲突难见尾声，全球经济面临不确定性。
- **希腊山火致三名消防员殉职**，强风令克里特岛多个村庄撤离，南欧多国仍在应对野火（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyjgwg8jddo)）。
- **萨尔曼·拉什迪案**：被告哈迪·马塔尔被判恐怖主义罪名成立，袭击意在帮助真主党（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c86ng1g5wy4o)）。
- **演员杰瑞德·莱托**面临10名女性指控，包括未成年人，律师否认（[BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cd7lg2nz2x2o)）。

中东战事与欧洲极端天气是当前欧美社会两大主线，战争的外溢效应（石油、市场、难民）将逐步显现。
欧美.en:
The US-Iran conflict escalated dramatically with 'heavy' US strikes on Iran after an attempted attack on American troops. Saudi Arabia, caught in the middle, faces a difficult diplomatic choice. Concurrently, Israeli strikes in Gaza and southern Lebanon continue to cause displacement and casualties. In other news, the attacker of Salman Rushdie was convicted, and actor Jared Leto faces new sexual misconduct allegations. European wildfires have killed three Greek firefighters.

- US launches 'heavy' strikes on Iran after troops attacked. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/c74gwdzywmeo)
- Saudi Arabia struggles to avoid being drawn into US-Iran war. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/clyx83l8jv8o)
- Israeli strikes in Gaza City leave buildings burning, families displaced. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/30/israeli-strikes-leave-buildings-burning-in-gaza-city)
- Southern Lebanon village divided by Israel's Yellow Line. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/video/newsfeed/2026/7/30/living-with-fear-inside-a-southern-lebanon-village-divided-by-israel)
- Three Greek firefighters die in Crete wildfires; France battles 40°C heat. [BBC](https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/articles/cwyjgwg8jddo)

Closing signal: The Mideast powder keg threatens further conflagration, with knock-on effects for global energy markets and a potential humanitarian crisis.

日韩.zh:
日本熊本地震成为核心冲击，韩国市场则受中东冲突波及而剧烈震荡。

- **熊本强震：AEON Mall坍塌，救援进行中**。7月29日熊本发生强烈地震，刚重开十年的AEON购物中心再度遭受重创，首相高市早苗称“与时间赛跑”（[半岛](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/30/like-volcanic-ash-falling-inside-aeon-mall-after-japans-earthquake)；[Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifEFVX3lxTE4yamF6S1ZkU1JLQ0xpM3pjeVVMcjB6WldCUzM2UmMycGJSN2NBcTRjbFBiaG5WSllUcHlWMEJGeEQzLVYycEJfSTM0bkd0UG9hdF90YVYtWC1fbXdsb1cyazhzdjE2aVFPWTg2QjNWSVprQTA4VV90THNuOTU)）。韩国外交部确认无韩国公民伤亡（[koreatimes](https://news.google.)）。
- **韩国股市重挫**：KOSPI指数暴跌6%，主因中东战火推升油价（[MyChamplainValley](https://news.google.)）。三星Q2营业利润创纪录达89.5万亿韩元，但市场担忧后续出口受冲突与汇率影响（[Korea Herald](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiV0FVX3lxTE5OZzU2NVROcjgweFRDTy13SlhDd0J6N3hVcE5PeGRoZkV5MmpNdm44MW5xcEFsTkFNdmVQTTVGanVsRHlUNllSZzYzUlhQMWhBZmxxMFo2Zw)）。
- **韩国女性网络侦探**自发对抗AI深度伪造色情，展现民间科技维权力量（[Japan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOVXp2ZXZVYXdRZmhmRWN0NU9iZE5NSDduVjdhYkIxN19nTDJ1dTU0SktlWlF6S3AxaUc0eGJRTmQ3aWtQZ0NOa0tyMFNqdUhiUzlTREtQSEJHSmYteVpCNnhZeFlOaWZ0ZlNVcThBd1N3R3BFOGhyR19xdEdPbklWaU1LUjlFeDBKUUI4M2hBd3JIbFA0YTc4)）。

日韩正同时承受自然灾害与地缘经济冲击，日本救援进展与韩国市场情绪将是后续焦点。
日韩.en:
Japan is reeling from a massive earthquake in Kumamoto that caused a newly reopened Aeon mall to collapse, with rescuers racing to find survivors. South Korea reports no casualties and is monitoring the situation, while its Kospi index fell 6% amid global market turbulence from Middle East tensions. Other notable stories include South Korea's tourism recovery surpassing pre-Covid levels and local women fighting AI deepfake porn.

- Rescuers race to find survivors after Kumamoto quake; PM calls it 'race against time'. [Japan Times](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNbS1IQmJkN01lNklzeTFTbDRQdkhib0gtTzk3LTY4N3VyTi1tUnVGS3NYeDZxdVNyckZTd1loYk5odU9aX203LUlxWHJaeGVsdXhjV2JGeGV6dXppbDFWMXFVSGFIOTBtWEFUanZ5Q3oyeV8wVnlaeUxRc0RHZXZHbW9ndVd3dmU5)
- 'Like volcanic ash falling' – inside Aeon mall after quake. [Al Jazeera](https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/7/30/like-volcanic-ash-falling-inside-aeon-mall-after-japans-earthquake)
- South Korea receives 10.7 million foreign visitors in H1, surpassing pre-Covid levels. [VnExpress](https://news.google.)
- South Korea's women web sleuths fight AI deepfake porn. [Japan Today](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxOVXp2ZXZVYXdRZmhmRWN0NU9iZE5NSDduVjdhYkIxN19nTDJ1dTU0SktlWlF6S3AxaUc0eGJRTmQ3aWtQZ0NOa0tyMFNqdUhiUzlTREtQSEJHSmYteVpCNnhZeFlOaWZ0ZlNVcThBd1N3R3BFOGhyR19xdEdPbklWaU1LUjlFeDBKUUI4M2hBd3JIbFA0YTc4)
- Kospi falls 6% as oil prices surge from Middle East tensions. [MyChamplainValley](https://news.google.)

Closing signal: Japan's rescue efforts and recovery will dominate the region's news cycle, while South Korea navigates external shocks from both natural disasters and geopolitical conflict.

中国.zh:
中国社会新闻24小时内以教育、科技和民生政策为主旋律，AI赋能与一带一路教育合作亮点突出。

- **中国—东盟教育交流周第19届开幕**，聚焦“数智教育”等四大合作，19年间累计2.09万东盟学子留学贵州（[Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQRGVYQ0JsUklkMS10QURpd3hOMkRHN0NpRlp6TU5iSTdaNEd3cm91TjM4bWlQV0JFMGVKaFo0cGJSZ0lkeDlzQ3BQUC1lODJJSFFtOVZjaWhxclMtZXRNREM1dW5uTzJDSnlRS3dWZmJ1SGlKb3U4eUJOeTA5b1lVNnBHYkdjUXJjbThJ)；[fznews](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZEFVX3lxTE5Ba19vTUd1U2FzQ1dVb0lDbk5MX2ZIQkJuRVkwZFhuWnQ3Sno1OTA0a1hISkVKQ0ZIczRmZDVtWXpTb0NEUFlpeGg0bXdhS1Y4RHhxWnVRTEFIWl9LUG5ucHUwTG4)）。
- **AI深度介入教育**：华南理工大学推出“两层云架构”解决高校AI落地难题（[edu.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTE91N0xScVdlOTFsNDQ3YjFpOTlwSk4tWTRlTThsN2IzU3J0RmlQOWdMNldSVGVKN1dmTG82VW1oaTJKS0dUd2JIMWxuUlpyZXIwb05mMExSWXYyZW1YQkQyTWRuUTNHMnc)），多所学校引入AI教学助手（[中国教育新闻网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTE1WdFZhZjdKUkI3aF9abmtFU3IzeGlZTEx1VVFUNkdKUnJlU1JoOEZFdjFjM2h0N3FDcWMwVV94TWd3bDRkcHJIQm1DanRJMnU1ck16MnQyNzBDcDhjX1VzNy1JbzhsSU9TazBB)）。
- **民生政策**：北京“十五五”持续推进老旧小区改造（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE50eVEyNUVSN20zeTVkYXRtMVhsYmt4VUp1b19yOUJlWkRPeThWQnh6SHRUMU9Cejd6VjNZaGdVTmd3eTlHX09JeGd0Q29VSFJscTFEeklVUExneENKeUtLdTdGeERxbWxueHFkYnZ3VVVLamxpNlNzVnFaNTNDUQ)）；企业年金转移接续新规出台，提升“便携性”（[新华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQbk5YeWxaYzVKTVYtM0o2bVh4b0M1aExvRGw3M3lxcl94MVRGeDBYakFaR1dGR1VRTFZjMU9KUFQ4Y016am1wM0s4LXNLZjBEYndwVnFUZDFwdzBybVRKQzFCUXFBMzFtbVg2SzN4YnUtd3UtUDYzTlQteGJlSldrODNJSnRQZXJM)）。
- **暑假安全公开课**即将上线（[thepaper.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBYQWdmYjExNmFZUmhwWVJ4ZmVaWGRHM1RYOVRzUmtGUTRPN0hnWWVOSFdGNmI1OFNPeTM2X2tSMVo3S0dQeHN0bWFFSU40andKVnFFeXhKQjZqQXJKWmc)）。

中国社会当前重心在于教育数字化与民生保障，国际教育合作彰显“一带一路”软实力。
中国.en:
China's domestic news is centered on education, AI, and social policy. The 2026 China-ASEAN Education Exchange Week opened, focusing on digital education and AI collaboration. New policies on enterprise annuity portability improve worker mobility, and Beijing plans to continue old community renovations through the 15th Five-Year Plan. AI is being integrated into classrooms, with a 'two-layer cloud architecture' case at South China University of Technology.

- China-ASEAN Education Exchange Week opens for 19th year, emphasizing digital cooperation. [altxw.com](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMia0FVX3lxTFBISFNIN0gyWng5WnJ3Vm9pclZZUnI0ZWhtLVM2Z2Q3UTBEVmEzRTR4SlBydWx5ZHQwWlRkYmdZM003SmxQLWN6M1FFNjNnNHRpeFNWcFNxWkR4STNDVzJjVVhXaHhtWGxad0dN)
- New regulations improve 'portability' of enterprise annuities, easing job switching. [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxQbk5YeWxaYzVKTVYtM0o2bVh4b0M1aExvRGw3M3lxcl94MVRGeDBYakFaR1dGR1VRTFZjMU9KUFQ4Y016am1wM0s4LXNLZjBEYndwVnFUZDFwdzBybVRKQzFCUXFBMzFtbVg2SzN4YnUtd3UtUDYzTlQteGJlSldrODNJSnRQZXJM)
- Beijing to continue old community renovation in '15th Five-Year' period. [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE50eVEyNUVSN20zeTVkYXRtMVhsYmt4VUp1b19yOUJlWkRPeThWQnh6SHRUMU9Cejd6VjNZaGdVTmd3eTlHX09JeGd0Q29VSFJscTFEeklVUExneENKeUtLdTdGeERxbWxueHFkYnZ3VVVLamxpNlNzVnFaNTNDUQ)
- AI 'teaching assistants' in classrooms: South China University of Technology unveils two-layer cloud architecture for AI deployment. [edu.cn](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTE91N0xScVdlOTFsNDQ3YjFpOTlwSk4tWTRlTThsN2IzU3J0RmlQOWdMNldSVGVKN1dmTG82VW1oaTJKS0dUd2JIMWxuUlpyZXIwb05mMExSWXYyZW1YQkQyTWRuUTNHMnc)
- Logistics sector shows steady operation with structural optimization in first half of 2026. [Xinhua](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTFBNVTlEdk5vMWQxMUlISnFUWmY3aTN5ZXNXQ0JqVzVoc1BLXzJDZmhTTXByRzl6N29vcHprZG8tUXc5c3VvTUl0UzA2SFdMUE5FeHFibDJEcDdyWFY2WGJDR2pyeHNSbHBwOXhHa2JGWGRiY0ZHSG0xYnJJRjZudw)

Closing signal: China's domestic agenda remains focused on social stability, education modernization, and gradual policy improvements, insulated from the Middle East turmoil.

知乎社区动态.zh:
知乎社区因两名华人数学家——王虹与邓煜——同获菲尔兹奖而沸腾，既有崇拜也有尴尬反转。

- **邓煜、王虹获奖引发热议**。此前有知乎网友曾批评二人“水平低”，如今销声匿迹（[新唐人](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5WSE5rTWNlTnFQZEJHOS10VTFtWlNIRVhYUHZjbmZIS2RLOUd4RV9uRExTeDQ2T1RwY19jX1ljT1JWY0Z3bURrN3ktZ3lvNG40MFJ3TG9tOExzaU5XdWdlMdIBZkFVX3lxTE80OGZEWTBRV1VvRWVsNzRRRG56X0tJRmcwV1k2TGhDWWoyQzY2bWJwY21vc0tENWlEWVU5TkdFSEVtckJZWGU4X3pNY2NKSEE1OTRJOHVSQkt3c3l1X256blhjMndxUQ)）。同时，王虹佩戴的卡地亚同款项链被带火（[4A广告网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTE85MU50ZGJJRVcxYkE0LVMyVW9TUjVrbi1oNGxBUFdnazhvN3E1b0gycTdjX1I0ZGpNV3FXSzcwQjRlb3RhZ1htSDBidG5ycWxMbHdFWFgtZm1aWE9WbWc0)），学术顶流意外拉动消费。
- **河南医院药剂科主任被曝受贿**：卖药10亿，个人提成2千多万，引发医药反腐讨论（[aboluowang](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1HcGZicGtOekwwT3ZpWTZvRHBLeXptazUwUzk0TTQyV1VaY0swUHpLck9aS0Nvd0R3NlEwUE9JRHhoTU1KNnBlcU4zb3ZEb0NrN2M1MEFqaGttR1phQ2fSAWNBVV95cUxPTlhlNlNOT3pTV2p3YnZEYkRNTmlQVmxkZXp4cnFBaF9UN1JqenRzTTJkR1FZOExkOE5hcTNoQks0ZlBBbzBHS1d0aDBHUE9GRzliTG1XeEVrbWRaNDMzYXpiaGM)）。
- **知乎机构认同度**有财经分析提及（[TradingKey](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE9nVFN4SjlWRkJJbHh5UVFrTlFOMlVKRDJOU2I4ZUNabW9ubVhrUU5Yai1vNUxHb3F0eEQ3RFNXNzFoNkY3SlBOQUgzWmJKZU1XNE9Rc1Q1MlpIbzZXUlJaVjVXbzB1SkpMcVZ3d25ZOA)），但社区本身的讨论热度显然由菲尔兹奖主导。

知乎社区这次展现了知识偶像商业化的奇妙联动，也再次验证“打脸”是社区最喜闻乐见的叙事之一。
知乎社区动态.en:
The Zhihu community is abuzz with discussion around two mathematicians: 邓煜, who won the Fields Medal, and 王虹, whose Fields Medal success has driven a spike in sales of a Cartier necklace she wore. A user who previously criticized both mathematicians has apparently deleted their account out of embarrassment. On a darker note, a hospital pharmacy director in Henan was found to have sold 1 billion yuan worth of drugs, pocketing over 20 million in kickbacks.

- 邓煜's Fields Medal win leads to a reassessment of his work on Zhihu. [fengwen](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE5GNVZPdVpQWFY0bUdWUFR5NEx3T29PR0RGLWZhWkRIMTJtVXA5Mi1IeFJNTm1oT29fZ244VG5NODVDTldxVEM4ZGJfaDNTSzdiRXlVZFRHYW0tcFU)
- 王虹's Fields Medal success boosts sales of a Cartier necklace she wore. [4A广告网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiX0FVX3lxTE85MU50ZGJJRVcxYkE0LVMyVW9TUjVrbi1oNGxBUFdnazhvN3E1b0gycTdjX1I0ZGpNV3FXSzcwQjRlb3RhZ1htSDBidG5ycWxMbHdFWFgtZm1aWE9WbWc0)
- A Zhihu user who previously derided 王虹 and 邓煜's work deletes account amid backlash. [新唐人](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYEFVX3lxTE5WSE5rTWNlTnFQZEJHOS10VTFtWlNIRVhYUHZjbmZIS2RLOUd4RV9uRExTeDQ2T1RwY19jX1ljT1JWY0Z3bURrN3ktZ3lvNG40MFJ3TG9tOExzaU5XdWdlMdIBZkFVX3lxTE80OGZEWTBRV1VvRWVsNzRRRG56X0tJRmcwV1k2TGhDWWoyQzY2bWJwY21vc0tENWlEWVU5TkdFSEVtckJZWGU4X3pNY2NKSEE1OTRJOHVSQkt3c3l1X256blhjMndxUQ)
- Henan hospital pharmacy director sells 1 billion yuan in drugs, takes 20 million yuan commission. [aboluowang](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1HcGZicGtOekwwT3ZpWTZvRHBLeXptazUwUzk0TTQyV1VaY0swUHpLck9aS0Nvd0R3NlEwUE9JRHhoTU1KNnBlcU4zb3ZEb0NrN2M1MEFqaGttR1phQ2fSAWNBVV95cUxPTlhlNlNOT3pTV2p3YnZEYkRNTmlQVmxkZXp4cnFBaF9UN1JqenRzTTJkR1FZOExkOE5hcTNoQks0ZlBBbzBHS1d0aDBHUE9GRzliTG1XeEVrbWRaNDMzYXpiaGM)

Closing signal: The Zhihu community is a microcosm of Chinese internet culture, mixing intellectual celebration, consumerism fallout, and real-world corruption scandals—all in one day.

国际安全.zh:
**概览：** 美伊冲突成为绝对焦点，24小时内发生导弹袭击、空袭报复和沙特加入等多重变量。中国向伊朗运送防空导弹的报道为局势增添第三国因素。
- 美国对伊朗目标实施空袭，此前伊朗导弹袭击驻约旦美军被拦截 ([NY Post](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxNaUMyazQ5ZUVMSWgxcHkxY0tKakNvODNlc0tvblpSQWc0Nm53NUt6WmZCUVVQY25NZjBsaEZOMW5FMm9mVUdiS2Z4aC1adEllaTZjZGh6aXJKdV81SGdabk55RC01djdXWlhMUGwtNUlOeHcxZmpTWUUtTDA0SFdlMmVsNEhXSVNOcWtMMWg0THVBWVdBM28xX3hPME02S29GV1NnVWVZRlQ4ZmVlWkJVc3FKV0FTMWR0ZWNz))，特朗普威胁“报复” ([NBC News](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxOV3JOYlFiUXFyNW54dFJ4TjN3QmoyT2xYOEdORm80bWJOQXVCUXNFa2ZOUFFseVdlRUhHSGllZUZDT29ObkM2cTNaRzVwYXlPT2l6b3J1czZwel9jZlBORUl1VVdjZXk5SV9CMG5Fd2ZVUUwzeFNLb05weWw5MnVmRVgzVF9lYWQ0bldEV0lSR1VRNWN5REpnZl9oODVVTGtqM3JadmNGVUZYTjZOalViRXMyYmRaT1k))。
- 中国被指在特朗普与习近平“友谊”背景下仍向伊朗提供防空导弹 ([AOL](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNVm03cTNFb3ZYTVBCUUNyLXAxaEhadEw4bUdNWUgyZDdhSWo5cGZ1N3RpYUc5VzVmOGdsUzE0N0ZvRk16OF9KNjdEaldlNG81U3BYblczTEU1alFuNXpYZDRMYXYwTjNrbzlFemltUS1tS3lCTFVZRmIwLXd6M2pnWQ))，显示中伊防务合作的战略性。
- 沙特阿拉伯首次加入美军对伊拉克境内伊朗代理人的空袭 ([BBC](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5FSzhZbndQb2lHQ1lnZ3FRaHdYZ1FLVGMzM1AxdnFvWWE3cW9FQW1CYlBYOGxrTnVJdXJCbXloU2V1b29xS0w0dHZYMFlNaGN2bUtxNUZ1ZXdJZw))，海湾安全格局发生重大重组。
- 北约与乌克兰启动新反无人机基金 ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/ukraine-nato-launch-new-funding-program-to-counter-russian-drones/))，同时美国考虑授权乌克兰生产“爱国者”系统 ([Breaking Defense](https://breakingdefense.com/2026/07/pentagon-weighing-options-to-license-patriot-production-to-ukraine-dod-official/))，俄乌战场防空压力持续。

**判断：** 美伊冲突已从代理人战争走向直接军事交锋，且沙特倒向美国阵营将进一步削弱伊朗在阿拉伯世界的立足点。中国向伊朗出口武器可能引发美国新一轮制裁，中美关系面临新考验。
国际安全.en:
A dramatic escalation: U.S. forces struck Iranian-linked targets in Iraq after thwarting a missile attack on American troops. Saudi Arabia joined the airstrikes, signaling a coalition approach, while China began anti-air missile deliveries to Iran, complicating the strategic picture. Two long-term threat assessments—NATO's warning on Russia and a new Singapore interest in GCAP—round out the desk.

- **U.S. strikes Iran after foiled attack** – The U.S. military launched airstrikes on Iranian proxies in Iraq and Syria in response to a failed missile barrage on American forces. This marks the first direct U.S. offensive against Iranian assets under Trump's second term ([US military launches airstrikes on Iran](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiuwFBVV95cUxNaUMyazQ5ZUVMSWgxcHkxY0tKakNvODNlc0tvblpSQWc0Nm53NUt6WmZCUVVQY25NZjBsaEZOMW5FMm9mVUdiS2Z4aC1adEllaTZjZGh6aXJKdV81SGdabk55RC01djdXWlhMUGwtNUlOeHcxZmpTWUUtTDA0SFdlMmVsNEhXSVNOcWtMMWg0THVBWVdBM28xX3hPME02S29GV1NnVWVZRlQ4ZmVlWkJVc3FKV0FTMWR0ZWNz)).

- **China sends anti-air missiles to Iran** – Despite Trump’s claim of friendship with Xi Jinping, Chinese anti-air missiles are headed to Iran, directly aiding a state under U.S. military pressure ([China sending anti-air missiles to Iran](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxNVm03cTNFb3ZYTVBCUUNyLXAxaEhadEw4bUdNWUgyZDdhSWo5cGZ1N3RpYUc5VzVmOGdsUzE0N0ZvRk16OF9KNjdEaldlNG81U3BYblczTEU1alFuNXpYZDRMYXYwTjNrbzlFemltUS1tS3lCTFVZRmIwLXd6M2pnWQ)).

- **NATO warns of Russian attack by 2029** – In a stark assessment, alliance generals state Russia could be ready for conflict with NATO in three years, but NATO won’t meet readiness goals until 2035 ([Alliance Generals: Russia May Attack Europe by 2029](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE9nUGFlZlo1aEVwQXZQQmlaaTZTRk1FVGs3WkRpYi1hN1E2X0NZQVFfMVhfakthRVZ1ZnMxV3RXRjNGSzI0Q0l6Y1N4SnpOY28)).

- **Singapore eyes GCAP 6th-gen fighter** – Already an F-35 buyer, Singapore is reportedly interested in the Global Combat Air Programme (GCAP), indicating a shift toward next-generation air power in the Indo-Pacific ([Singapore Reportedly Looking Toward 6th Gen Fighter](https://www.twz.com/air/singapore-reportedly-looking-toward-6th-gen-fighter-future-with-interest-in-gcap-program)).

**Signal:** The convergence of U.S.-Iran kinetic strikes, Chinese arms supply to Tehran, and NATO’s urgent war warning suggests a multipolar flashpoint landscape; readers should watch for any second-strike attacks from Iran’s proxies in the next 24 hours.

冲突局势.zh:
**概览：** 中东战场扩大化，伊拉克再次成为美伊代理人战场，红海航运安全恶化，胡塞武装威胁对曼德海峡收费。
- 伊朗高调测试“更具对抗性的战略” ([伊朗国际](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTFBFakJzS1BGVXRCUWxVeUpfSEpFdHJGMGQxb010ajdHTlNkU2gwNThuVkc2cmc4MDljYWdiUFNhZUpwY2M3TkNWalBnaVRjVGtpOHc))，可能包括对更远距离目标的打击。
- 沙特酝酿组建红海联军以反制伊朗支持的组织 ([Al-Monitor](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTFBFOXI4QjUwSnVCY3l1VEhiZFB6cjJZb2FhUUFFSGtzTXdCVnEtME95Zms4MTU5OE9LQ2NTcnRvNjdMdFozVEJ6Sy1jeGFKd1ZQWXc))，可能与空袭伊拉克同步。
- 一架无人机击中埃及地中海港口的一艘天然气储油船 ([Reuters](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxPM3F5LWg3Mm9rYmlhejJpdzJqQW9SWnU1WHJRVm9iZ1p0TUpmRTR6Mk1JYXVUekU2c1VlTHI5bV9DbzIyejlvYU13Y2cxYU12WExOYzJoVmxsVzVoc2hiWkQ2ZWFUZ0EwZHBZZlZ1UnREZjZGc243TlQtMXVKcDQ5bUpEaDR2Tmo5eTJkdlJhSXMtZ0U2cnk0OWNLLU50YlBjbnZrei1FVm9CYWw5cUE))，红海-地中海航运威胁已从也门外溢。
- 航运业呼吁保护平民海员 ([gCaptain](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNSW9pS0JyNG1HTGItQTljdmhHYWZoaGxYMXROX2hpRnVZbmFvcnYtRXNKSy05QlBrSEwzYS0xX2VrMGFSSzZCMloycDFNTFFOU21DZlRuQTNfQ3ZCSEZzRGNlaC05NzRveDd6OTN5TjdfZVhqbEhLTzRtMHgyand6b1pYaGR0eWpUYkl3RDIzYzFXRFJJaDRyNWR3NVI5c1IwYjJXWXZCTGpYVXNJaEpCX05vYkljdw))，全球贸易安全成本上升。

**判断：** 冲突已从也门内战演变为区域海空大战，伊拉克的重返战场表明伊朗与美国的对抗将更持久。胡塞武装的曼德海峡收费威胁若实施，将直接冲击全球能源和贸易流量。
冲突局势.en:
Iran is testing a more confrontational strategy after striking U.S. forces in Jordan, drawing U.S.-Saudi retaliatory strikes in Iraq. A drone hit on a gas tanker at Egypt's Mediterranean port and Houthi threats to toll the Bab al-Mandeb Strait underscore the widening maritime and energy security risks. The shipping industry is demanding protection for civilian seafarers.

- **Iran tests confrontational strategy** – Tehran’s direct missile attack on U.S. troops in Jordan represents a strategic shift from proxy warfare to state-on-state pressure ([Tehran tests a more confrontational strategy](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiUkFVX3lxTFBFakJzS1BGVXRCUWxVeUpfSEpFdHJGMGQxb010ajdHTlNkU2gwNThuVkc2cmc4MDljYWdiUFNhZUpwY2M3TkNWalBnaVRjVGtpOHc)).

- **Saudi Arabia joins U.S. in Iraq strikes** – For the first time, Riyadh participated in airstrikes inside Iraq against Iran-backed militias, a major policy shift that could reshape the regional balance ([Saudi Arabia joins US in strikes on Iran-backed militias in Iraq](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiWkFVX3lxTE5FSzhZbndQb2lHQ1lnZ3FRaHdYZ1FLVGMzM1AxdnFvWWE3cW9FQW1CYlBYOGxrTnVJdXJCbXloU2V1b29xS0w0dHZYMFlNaGN2bUtxNUZ1ZXdJZw)).

- **Drone hits gas storage tanker at Egyptian port** – An explosive-laden drone struck a natural gas tanker at Damietta, Egypt, highlighting the vulnerability of critical energy infrastructure to asymmetric attacks ([Drone hits gas storage tanker at Egypt's Mediterranean port](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxPM3F5LWg3Mm9rYmlhejJpdzJqQW9SWnU1WHJRVm9iZ1p0TUpmRTR6Mk1JYXVUekU2c1VlTHI5bV9DbzIyejlvYU13Y2cxYU12WExOYzJoVmxsVzVoc2hiWkQ2ZWFUZ0EwZHBZZlZ1UnREZjZGc243TlQtMXVKcDQ5bUpEaDR2Tmo5eTJkdlJhSXMtZ0U2cnk0OWNLLU50YlBjbnZrei1FVm9CYWw5cUE)).

- **Shipping industry calls for protection of civilian seafarers** – As maritime threats surge, industry groups are urging governments to secure sea lines and provide safe passage for crews ([Shipping Industry Urges Protection for Civilian Seafarers](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitgFBVV95cUxNSW9pS0JyNG1HTGItQTljdmhHYWZoaGxYMXROX2hpRnVZbmFvcnYtRXNKSy05QlBrSEwzYS0xX2VrMGFSSzZCMloycDFNTFFOU21DZlRuQTNfQ3ZCSEZzRGNlaC05NzRveDd6OTN5TjdfZVhqbEhLTzRtMHgyand6b1pYaGR0eWpUYkl3RDIzYzFXRFJJaDRyNWR3NVI5c1IwYjJXWXZCTGpYVXNJaEpCX05vYkljdw)).

**Signal:** The spread of conflict from Iraq and Jordan to the Mediterranean and Red Sea pressures global energy routes; a sustained campaign against maritime infrastructure could trigger insurance spikes and supply chain disruptions.

海军与印太.zh:
**概览：** 美国海军核心水下力量更新取得进展，同时RIMPAC演习展现无人系统实战化趋势，美台海岸警卫队合作首次公开化。
- 美国海军授予通用动力和HII总计766亿美元合同，建造9艘弗吉尼亚级和5艘哥伦比亚级潜艇 ([USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/29/navy-awards-76-6b-for-9-virginia-5-columbia-subs-to-general-dynamics-hii))，为近三年最大单一造船项目。
- RIMPAC 2026期间完成35项以上无人系统与新兴技术试验 ([USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/29/more-than-35-experiments-test-unmanned-systems-emerging-technologies-during-rimpac))，重点包括跨军种/盟国互操作性。
- 美海岸警卫队公开与台湾海巡署联合演练画面 ([USNI](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/29/u-s-reveals-coast-guard-cooperation-with-taiwan))，虽未透露时间地点，但政治信号强烈。
- 韩华海洋与美国签署多项合作备忘录，涉及舰船设计、供应链等 ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/hanwha-ocean-advances-korea-u-s-shipbuilding-cooperation-through-naval-vessel-development-and-broader-industry-collaboration/))，韩美造船合作实质化。
- 澳大利亚选定Leidos Gibbs & Cox设计AUKUS浮船坞 ([Naval News](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/australia-selects-leidos-gibbs-cox-for-aukus-dry-dock-design/))，核潜艇基础设施加紧建设。

**判断：** 美国海军正全力推进“水下舰队扩容”和“盟国海上能力整合”两条主线，台海方向通过非军方渠道（海岸警卫队）建立事实合作，意在降低冲突风险的同时增强存在感。
海军与印太.en:
The U.S. Navy finalized a record $76.6 billion submarine contract after long delays, while RIMPAC 2026 pushed unmanned systems interoperability with over 35 experiments. Revelations of U.S.-Taiwan coast guard exercises and AUKUS dry dock design selections show the alliance network deepening in the Indo-Pacific.

- **U.S. Navy awards $76.6B for Virginia- and Columbia-class subs** – General Dynamics and HII split contracts for nine Block VI Virginia-class attack subs and five Columbia-class ballistic missile subs, ending a three-year funding gap critical to the nuclear modernization timeline ([Navy Awards $76.6B for 9 Virginia, 5 Columbia Subs](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/29/navy-awards-76-6b-for-9-virginia-5-columbia-subs-to-general-dynamics-hii)).

- **RIMPAC runs 35+ unmanned system experiments** – During the biennial exercise, U.S. and partner forces tested drones, AI, and autonomous systems to enhance maritime domain awareness and coalition interoperability ([More than 35 Experiments Test Unmanned Systems During RIMPAC](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/29/more-than-35-experiments-test-unmanned-systems-emerging-technologies-during-rimpac)).

- **U.S. reveals coast guard cooperation with Taiwan** – For the first time, the U.S. publicly acknowledged joint exercises between the U.S. Coast Guard and Taiwan’s Coast Guard Administration, a significant step in deepening de facto security ties ([U.S. Reveals Coast Guard Cooperation with Taiwan](https://news.usni.org/2026/07/29/u-s-reveals-coast-guard-cooperation-with-taiwan)).

- **Australia selects Leidos Gibbs & Cox for AUKUS dry dock** – The floating dry dock design contract supports the future AUKUS nuclear-powered submarine maintenance infrastructure, a key enabler of the trilateral pact ([Australia Selects Leidos Gibbs & Cox for AUKUS Dry Dock Design](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/07/australia-selects-leidos-gibbs-cox-for-aukus-dry-dock-design/)).

**Signal:** The submarine contract renewal and AUKUS infrastructure moves signal sustained U.S. commitment to undersea dominance, but any delays could be offset by Chinese hypersonic anti-ship missile proliferation seen in the China desk.

中国军情.zh:
**概览：** 中国在南海与美日欧多边对峙中出动航母及26艘舰船进行“围观”，渤海军事演习，同时高超音速导弹上舰和军事AI研发取得新进展。
- 美航母坐镇，美日欧三路轮番在南海活动，解放军出动航母及26艘舰船进行“强势围观” ([搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNTmFRVnNGM09BN1lRME14R2NDOFVRc3hrTzlHbU5rdE84QlE4YlhtNG03TVR0N00tSjE3c1hmM3phLXJlZ21JT0pjcmdTa0prUHlnc2Z1cFBqNmY4UmU2YXlPMDdGU2ROTXZlREM3bXZ6X282Zjk3R25LWHM0cmYycXkxSnJhVVRtcXBMUg))，显示南海博弈进入“准常态化”对峙阶段。
- 军事科学院研究员张双喜撰文谈“中国特色人工智能创新发展之路” ([新浪](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFAyZmtscGFyUWJVT3RZS3A1eERrSE5QQ0xPcmc3N09oVjBHOGxUTkIyd05qUmhPbFhMSGxlS25wYzI1N3d4RW9DdkZwR2JZS2FZOTF0akxfX2J1UU5nZjBXOVVOUzRTMGZRQkFBM0RyTTNFZw))，暗示AI在指挥决策、无人系统方面的应用加速。
- 渤海部分海域进行军事演习，发布航行警告 ([中新网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE9RX1lkeW1YYm9VZ2NBenhkOVJ4Q1VoQnhZOTU3b0FzckJvcXhLUUtUdXpFOGxHekh3UnhSWXdkeGlaNWhuMVBWanctcWlkdlVHQUl2UDY0VVRWX201LUNMWVRPTmhGMFAx))，属于常规训练但时值敏感期。
- 五角大楼官员称“目前美中军事关系是近年来最稳固的” ([美国之音](https://news.google.))，但同日美国将部分中企列入“中国军事企业清单” ([财联社](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiSEFVX3lxTFBNNkFhZGRLZGRRLTdZQXJmUnkwSnFLNlRPWmhDMXd3WFN1R2tXa0dqTXhhcUJBdTExSEppOUpNZkg5a1AzS20xag))，美方对华政策呈现“合作与遏制并行”的矛盾。
- 台湾政治人物郑丽文呼吁只有国民党能确保台海和平 ([凤凰网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiTEFVX3lxTFBKblNhVW5qWmQ0RFBQYW9SY0FQeVZBaklxN0kzaDgyS3oxVGZvUDNTZDVxaTZmcno1MHBhNGJBN2Jvcy1aWUF5SzNFRE0))，岛内选举政治与安全议题绑定。

**判断：** 中国在南海通过“实力展示”应对多国联合巡航，但尚未突破擦枪走火的临界点。美中军事关系表面稳定，实则因供应链制裁、台海动向和伊朗问题而暗流涌动。解放军高超音速武器小型化部署是最大技术突破，将改变区域拒止/反介入的兵力分布。
中国军情.en:
China is simultaneously showcasing hypersonic strike capability by test-firing the YJ-20 from a Type 052D destroyer, while facing a multi-naval force in the South China Sea with 26 ships. Official commentary highlights military AI development and a Pentagon official's assessment that U.S.-China military relations are the most stable in years—a contradictory signal amid the tensions.

- **YJ-20 hypersonic missile tested from Type 052D destroyer** – The People's Liberation Army Navy demonstrated the integration of the YJ-20 hypersonic anti-ship missile onto a smaller destroyer, vastly expanding the number of hulls capable of delivering this weapon ([China Fires YJ-20 Hypersonic Anti-Ship Missile From Smaller Destroyer](https://www.twz.com/sea/china-fires-yj-20-hypersonic-anti-ship-missile-from-smaller-destroyer) and [Footage Confirms First Integration of Hypersonic Ballistic Missiles](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimgFBVV95cUxNYU00dVVwMjhlTEV1Q00xdl9RSEVpbl81RTlMRGtwbHlBdFdrM0xIdEZoQ1NKaHd3UXhlZmdCaGE3QXNHRHV0VEhLbVJFNE1QVGUxSE4tVHI4VEg4YTM0SUV0NmlLWF9pMEx4R0ZHNS11di1ZaXlaWDBkNHdRb3A0bk12aGRfcE1nMmJ3ek1PR0hTTVdSUk4wR0lR)).

- **26 Chinese ships shadow U.S.-led naval force in South China Sea** – Amid the outbreak of U.S.-Iran strikes, a carrier strike group backed by Japanese and European ships conducted exercises near disputed features. China responded with the largest naval “encirclement” since 2016, including a carrier ([美航母坐镇撑腰，美日欧三路轮番南海，26艘中国舰船“强势围观”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxNTmFRVnNGM09BN1lRME14R2NDOFVRc3hrTzlHbU5rdE84QlE4YlhtNG03TVR0N00tSjE3c1hmM3phLXJlZ21JT0pjcmdTa0prUHlnc2Z1cFBqNmY4UmU2YXlPMDdGU2ROTXZlREM3bXZ6X282Zjk3R25LWHM0cmYycXkxSnJhVVRtcXBMUg)).

- **Pentagon official calls U.S.-China military relations most stable in years** – A senior U.S. defense official stated that current military-to-military engagement with China is at its strongest, even as Beijing arms Iran and conducts massive naval shows of force ([五角大楼官员：目前的美中军事关系是近年来最为稳固的](https://news.google.)).

- **China conducts military AI research** – The PLA’s military science academy is exploring “AI with Chinese characteristics” for warfare, signaling Beijing’s intent to lead in military artificial intelligence ([走好中国特色人工智能创新发展之路](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTFAyZmtscGFyUWJVT3RZS3A1eERrSE5QQ0xPcmc3N09oVjBHOGxUTkIyd05qUmhPbFhMSGxlS25wYzI1N3d4RW9DdkZwR2JZS2FZOTF0akxfX2J1UU5nZjBXOVVOUzRTMGZRQkFBM0RyTTNFZw)).

- **Bohai Sea military exercise announced** – A navigation warning for live-fire drills in the Bohai Sea adds to the growing list of PLA activities around China's periphery ([航行警告！渤海部分海域进行军事演习 禁止驶入](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE9RX1lkeW1YYm9VZ2NBenhkOVJ4Q1VoQnhZOTU3b0FzckJvcXhLUUtUdXpFOGxHekh3UnhSWXdkeGlaNWhuMVBWanctcWlkdlVHQUl2UDY0VVRWX201LUNMWVRPTmhGMFAx)).

**Signal:** The PLA is at once projecting power in the South China Sea while expanding its hypersonic reach; the Pentagon’s “stable relations” remark may be an attempt to de-escalate, but the gap between words and actions is wide. Expect further drills and test launches in the coming week.

科技产品.zh:
今日科技产品领域政策风暴与市场动态并行。美国机器人禁令扩大化波及扫地机器人，FCC明确禁止进口中国产先进机器人；Qualcomm宣布9月涨价，手机成本压力加剧；Winamp借Deezer复活，怀旧牌能否奏效存疑。
- [US government robot ban also includes vacuums](https://www.engadget.com/2226533/the-us-government-robot-ban-also-includes-vacuums/) — Engadget报道FCC确认禁令涵盖扫地机器人，引发智能家居产业担忧。
- [Qualcomm is raising phone chip prices starting September 1st](https://www.theverge.com/tech/972894/qualcomm-price-hikes-q2-2026-earnings) — 高通CEO确认9月1日起全线涨价，叠加RAM涨价，消费者将面临更贵手机。
- [Winamp aims for a comeback with a new music player powered by Deezer](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/29/winamp-aims-for-a-comeback-with-a-new-music-player-powered-by-deezer/) — TechCrunch报道Winamp计划推出基于Deezer的付费音乐服务，试图利用怀旧品牌在拥挤市场中突围。
- [xAI's last-minute scramble to stop Minnesota's anti-nudification app law](https://www.theverge.com/policy/972850/xai-grok-minnesota-nudification-lawsuit) — xAI起诉明尼苏达州反裸体化应用法，称该法迫使Grok限制图像编辑功能，违反第一修正案。
- [Google Play is expanding age confirmation tools for app developers](https://www.engadget.com/2226632/google-play-is-expanding-age-confirmation-tools-for-app-developers/) — Google Play将全球推出Age Signals API，帮助开发者确认用户年龄。
收束判断：政策与成本双重挤压下，消费电子厂商需在合规与创新间平衡。
科技产品.en:
Consumer electronics saw several significant developments: Qualcomm announced processor price hikes from September 1st, the US government's robot import ban now explicitly covers robot vacuums (not just humanoids), and Winamp is attempting a comeback with a Deezer-powered service. Meanwhile, Google Play expands age confirmation tools globally, Xbox confirms game discs should have worked during its recent outage, and Apple's new Upgrade program is explained.

- **Qualcomm raising chip prices** starting Sept 1, adding to 'RAMageddon' cost pressures. [Source](https://www.theverge.com/tech/972894/qualcomm-price-hikes-q2-2026-earnings)
- **US robot ban includes vacuums** – FCC confirms Chinese-made robot vacuums, not just humanoids, are subject to new restrictions. [Source](https://www.engadget.com/2226533/the-us-government-robot-ban-also-includes-vacuums/) | [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/policy/972312/us-robot-ban-sweep-up-chinese-vacuums)
- **Winamp revival** aims to leverage nostalgia with a premium Deezer-powered player in a crowded streaming market. [Source](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/29/winamp-aims-for-a-comeback-with-a-new-music-player-powered-by-deezer/)
- **Google Play's Age Signals API** will expand globally by year-end to help developers verify user ages. [Source](https://www.engadget.com/2226632/google-play-is-expanding-age-confirmation-tools-for-app-developers/)
- **Cyberpunk 2077** is now a polished experience at a $20 discount, showcasing its transformation. [Source](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/972777/cyberpunk-2077-deal-sale)

Signal: Expect higher smartphone prices this fall due to Qualcomm's move, and watch for how appliance retailers react to the vacuum ban.

汽车.zh:
电动汽车市场高端与大众两极均现突破。Ferrari首款EV以64万美元售价迅速售罄，证明超豪华电动路线可行；Hyundai IONIQ 3以3万美元起价、300英里续航掀起预订热潮；固态电池产业化加速，SK On与Factorial联手。
- [Ferrari’s $640K Luce EV sells out 2026 allocation: ~500 units](https://electrek.co/2026/07/29/ferrari-luce-ev-sold-out-2026-allocation/) — Electrek报道Ferrari首款EV不到两个月售罄2026年产量（约500辆），打脸质疑者。
- [Hyundai reveals IONIQ 3 prices start at $30,000, and it already looks like a hit](https://electrek.co/2026/07/29/hyundai-reveals-ioniq-3-prices-start-30000-interest-surges/) — Hyundai宣布IONIQ 3起售价3万美元，超300英里续航，客户兴趣创历史新高。
- [The new Mercedes GLA EV is bigger, smarter, and has a range of over 400 miles](https://electrek.co/2026/07/29/new-mercedes-gla-ev-bigger-400-miles-range/) — 新款电动GLA续航超400英里，支持超快充，紧凑型SUV市场再添强手。
- [Two solid-state EV battery leaders are joining forces to scale the ‘breakthrough’ tech](https://electrek.co/2026/07/29/solid-state-ev-battery-leaders-team-up/) — SK On与Factorial合作推动固态电池量产，可能改变下一代电动车格局。
- [Ford Targets 2028 Robotaxi Launch, Adding to Tesla's Rivalry Risk](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE54ZnRyLUVoeXFaNUlSdThjQy1YTS01N19kMmJjZGhIVlJ1d1hhS2ktQWRfWllpeVNxMXZNUmM2eFJUbGxTWmVXSnJSOGFMSzZxLUUtbXY3QzRRYkk1QWQ3U2Rtc3FOdzZGVmU0d2t4MFB3MW54Umc) — 福特宣布2028年推出机器人出租车，加剧与特斯拉的竞争。
收束判断：从百万超跑到3万大众车型，电动化渗透率加速，电池技术突破是关键胜负手。
汽车.en:
The EV market saw a mix of luxury success and mainstream expansion. Ferrari's first EV, the Luce, sold out its 2026 allocation (about 500 units) in under two months despite design criticism. Hyundai's IONIQ 3 (starting at $30,000 with 300+ miles range) is generating record pre-order interest, while Waymo resumes freeway operations after a construction-related pause. Solid-state battery leaders SK On and Factorial Energy are joining forces to scale the technology.

- **Ferrari Luce EV sells out 2026 allocation** – ~500 units at $640K each, defying critics. [Source](https://electrek.co/2026/07/29/ferrari-luce-ev-sold-out-2026-allocation/) | [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/29/sorry-haters-ferraris-first-ev-is-doing-just-fine/)
- **Hyundai IONIQ 3** attracts 'more interest than any vehicle we've ever launched' – starting around $30,000 with over 300 miles range. [Source](https://electrek.co/2026/07/29/hyundai-reveals-ioniq-3-prices-start-30000-interest-surges/)
- **Waymo returns to freeways** after May pause due to construction zone incidents. [Source](https://www.engadget.com/2226530/waymos-are-starting-to-run-on-the-freeways-again/)
- **SK On + Factorial Energy** alliance aims to scale solid-state EV batteries for mass production. [Source](https://electrek.co/2026/07/29/solid-state-ev-battery-leaders-team-up/)

Signal: Affordable long-range EVs (Hyundai IONIQ 3) and luxury halo EVs (Ferrari Luce) are both finding demand, while solid-state battery partnerships signal a race to next-gen technology.

AI.zh:
AI行业巨头竞争白热化，微软与OpenAI、Anthropic关系复杂化；Zuckerberg预言五年内数十亿人拥有个人AI代理；韩国AI泡沫破裂引发反思。
- [Microsoft logs $3.2B from Anthropic investment, but OpenAI was a mixed bag](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/29/microsoft-logs-3-2b-from-anthropic-investment-but-openai-was-a-mixed-bag/) — TechCrunch报道微软从Anthropic投资获利32亿美元，同时OpenAI投资表现不一，显示微软在AI投资组合上的多重押注。
- [Microsoft confirms Copilot ‘super app’ coming this year](https://www.theverge.com/tech/972927/microsoft-copilot-super-app-confirmed) — The Verge确认微软计划今年推出Copilot超级应用，融合聊天、编码和代理功能。
- [Mark Zuckerberg predicts that billions of people will have personal AI agents in five years](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/29/mark-zuckerberg-predicts-that-billions-of-people-will-have-personal-ai-agents-in-five-years/) — Meta CEO预测五年内数十亿人使用个人AI代理，企业AI机会远超代理本身。
- [South Korea's AI Bubble Just Popped [video]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hy90LdpEUvQ) — 视频分析韩国AI泡沫破裂，可能引发全球对AI估值过高的重新评估。
- [Leopold Aschenbrenner's Situational Awareness seeks capital raise after AI rout](https://www.ft.com/content/280336bf-dbed-405f-b38e-5af644a21549) — FT报道《Situational Awareness》作者在AI暴跌后寻求融资，反映AI创业融资环境收紧。
收束判断：AI产业正从“拼模型”转向“拼应用与商业变现”，微软与Meta的策略差异将决定下一阶段格局。
AI.en:
The AI landscape is dominated by corporate rivalries and regulatory moves. Microsoft is openly competing with OpenAI and Anthropic, reporting a $3.2B gain from its Anthropic investment while confirming a Copilot 'super app' for later this year. Mark Zuckerberg predicts billions will have personal AI agents within five years. Meanwhile, South Korea's AI bubble appears to have popped, and the US considers creating a FINRA-style watchdog to vet top AI models. In community news, a new MCP protocol update and a Rust coding agent compatible with Claude Code saw interest.

- **Microsoft vs. AI labs** – Reports $3.2B profit from Anthropic, mixed results from OpenAI; confirms Copilot super app. [Source](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/29/microsoft-logs-3-2b-from-anthropic-investment-but-openai-was-a-mixed-bag/) | [The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/972927/microsoft-copilot-super-app-confirmed)
- **Zuckerberg's AI agent prediction** – billions will have personal agents in five years; Meta sees enterprise opportunity beyond agents. [Source](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/29/mark-zuckerberg-predicts-that-billions-of-people-will-have-personal-ai-agents-in-five-years/) | [TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/07/29/zuckerberg-says-metas-enterprise-ai-opportunity-extends-beyond-agents/)
- **South Korea's AI bubble pops** – multiple analysis videos and discussions on Hacker News. [Source](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=hy90LdpEUvQ) | [Source 2](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=qeXpUZTdvsI)
- **US considers AI watchdog** – FINRA-like body to vet top AI models, reported July 17. [Source](https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2026-07-17/us-considers-creating-finra-like-watchdog-to-vet-top-ai-models)
- **LLM Honeypot** – a tool to detect AI-generated text goes viral on Hacker News (111 points). [Source](https://llm2human.pages.dev/)
- **New MCP protocol** brings MCP 2026-07-28 to Claude. [Source](https://claude.com/blog/bringing-mcp-2026-07-28-to-claude)

Signal: The AI infrastructure spending race is intensifying, but investor sentiment may be cooling (South Korea). Watch for regulatory frameworks and the Copilot super app's launch.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
社区热议生产力反思、AI代理协作和空间计算创新。Vision Pro被用于看房获得极高关注；一篇关于“效率幻觉”的文章引发共鸣；“冷邮件”话题重温。
- [The coolest use for the Vision Pro](https://christianselig.com/2026/07/vision-pro-house/) — 用户分享用Vision Pro虚拟看房获471分，展示空间计算在房地产领域的实用价值。
- [The Productivity Mirage](https://frantic.im/mirage/) — 文章批评现代生产力工具反而导致效率下降，获93分，引发广泛讨论。
- [Show HN: A local merge queue for parallel Claude Code agents](https://github.com/funador/claude-code-merge-queue) — 开发者发布本地合并队列工具，管理并行Claude代智能体提交，解决8GB机器资源瓶颈，获关注。
- [The Cold Email](https://zachholman.com/posts/cold-email) — Zach Holman关于冷邮件的经典文章重登首页，127分，提醒销售沟通本质。
- [NSF pilots 4-year PhDs with industry research placements](https://www.nsf.gov/news/nsf-partners-universities-industry-pilot-initiative-four) — NSF启动四年制博士试点，与行业研究实习结合，获46分，反映学术界与产业界融合趋势。
收束判断：Hacker News社区持续关注工具效率、远程协作和职业发展，Vision Pro的创意应用预示着空间计算可能找到杀手用例。
HackNews社区动态.en:
The Hacker News community was highly engaged today with a mix of practical tools, philosophical posts, and career developments. The top story (471 points) is a creative use of Apple Vision Pro for home renovation, followed by reflections on cold emailing (127 points) and a critique of productivity culture (93 points). An NSF pilot for 4-year PhDs with industry placements sparked discussion (46 points), and a new book on logic for programmers was shared (28 points). The community also saw a Show HN for a local merge queue for parallel Claude Code agents.

- **Vision Pro for home design** – 'the coolest use for the Vision Pro' with 471 points and 201 comments. [Source](https://christianselig.com/2026/07/vision-pro-house/)
- **The Cold Email** – Zach Holman's essay on effective outreach, 127 points. [Source](https://zachholman.com/posts/cold-email)
- **The Productivity Mirage** – critique of productivity culture, 93 points. [Source](https://frantic.im/mirage/)
- **NSF pilots 4-year PhDs** with industry placements, 46 points. [Source](https://www.nsf.gov/news/nsf-partners-universities-industry-pilot-initiative-four)
- **Logic for Programmers** – Hillel Wayne's new book, 28 points. [Source](https://logicforprogrammers.com/)
- **Show HN: Local merge queue** for Claude Code agents to manage parallel commits. [Source](https://github.com/funador/claude-code-merge-queue)

Signal: The community is hungry for practical productivity tools and career hacks, while also reflecting on the deeper implications of AI-assisted workflows.

足球.zh:
今日足球新闻不多，但两条重磅信息值得关注。利物浦CEO Billy Hogan在纽约接受BBC专访，明确表示FSG正与多个财团进行投资谈判，强调“变革不可避免”，但不会完全出售俱乐部，这意味着红军可能迎来新股东但仍保留美资背景。另一边，国际足联正式对阿根廷国家队开启纪律处分程序，因世界杯决赛后球员与球迷冲突，以及比赛中展示福克兰群岛主权横幅，可能面临罚款或禁赛。

- [利物浦CEO：FSG正与财团谈判，变革不可避免](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c8xnvqrxv8ro)
- [FIFA对阿根廷启动纪律处分，涉决赛后行为及政治标语](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cp3rkwgy6y7o)

两件事均涉及顶级俱乐部的治理与国家队形象管理，后续发展将牵动球迷与投资者的神经。
足球.en:
The 足球 desk captured a wide range of sports today, from Commonwealth Games heroics to cricket scandals and football governance issues. The Commonwealth Games delivered gold for Scottish swimmer Angharad Evans and Northern Irish heptathlete Kate O'Connor, while England's netball team dominated Tonga. Cricket controversies remain front-page news with the Saltburn 'Clicky Ponting' scandal leading to a player suspension and broader industry debate. In football, FIFA charged Argentina over post-World Cup behavior and a Falklands banner; Liverpool CEO Billy Hogan outlined FSG's transition plans; and Gianni Infantino's World Cup sell-off proposal stirred debate. Other notable stories: Stephen Fleming expected as England Test coach, Sir Garfield Sobers' state funeral, Luke Littler's darting dominance, and boxing disqualification at the Commonwealth Games.

- [England netball crushes Tonga 94-32 at Commonwealth Games](https://www.skysports.com/netball/news/12040/13568214/commonwealth-games-england-dominate-tonga-in-must-win-contest-as-quest-for-semi-final-spot-continues)
- [Saltburn player suspended after 'finger-clicking' cheating allegations](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/cricket/articles/cg7m5grrp7ko)
- [FIFA opens disciplinary proceedings against Argentina](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cp3rkwgy6y7o)
- [Liverpool CEO talks FSG, Iraola and consortium talks](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/c8xnvqrxv8ro)
- [Infantino's World Cup sell-off plan under scrutiny](https://www.bbc.co.uk/sport/football/articles/cjejl274xx8o)

This diverse mix of Olympic sports, cricket controversies, and football politics keeps the desk highly dynamic heading into the weekend.

篮球.zh:
CBA和欧洲篮球市场今日消息密集。CBA出台新规：下赛季所有大学生球员必须先参加CBA选秀，落选后才能加盟NBL，此举旨在规范人才流动，减少暗箱操作。同时，深圳队外援阿利兹·约翰逊接近加盟法甲巴黎篮球俱乐部，继多名CBA外援转投欧洲后，CBA外援吸引力面临考验。球员故事方面，山西队后卫曹芷豪在专访中表示要以防守立足，偶像詹姆斯；前NBA状元奥登则爆料在CBA半年赚百万美元，每天抽一包烟，引发对CBA职业素养的反思。

- [CBA新规：大学生球员须先选秀再考虑NBL](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxPTFM5ZlpTTWtZaG0wM095MGU3M1kydnJnaWh4VjNrazlHaG5DXzBLckI4eVlGSXRWdTNQUDZrUllZTjJxaE9ETl8wbjFkbVZtZG1PMy1UNGIzTlY3RXJSN0xlRGhSZGpzZDdXV3lKSUlKSzE3Qm9FeEk2LURvZFppTUZ3VzVYaDlTYV9IV1pHeGpyUUY1ak9R)
- [前深圳外援阿利兹·约翰逊接近加盟巴黎篮球俱乐部](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPQjdFUTBWcmdKNXZlZGJGVXZGd1JpTXJhNGVEM1h6el9BTnFzb0hDVlZETU1pU0xKU015MFJRb2NPejltUnNMUkUwM2d5Q2trTzlVRWsxcE9tOFhZdGlIZnBTWnB2N3B4eXVwaTNGUXhZcGRBV0dYY2pUS29kWGtCNDcyRWw0S1VvY0JFQQ)
- [曹芷豪：想成为赵睿那样全面的后卫，偶像詹姆斯](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE5SYjhBSDBmbkpEZHRnQnUxNC1YZTl2NFQzejRtZzROMHBXS3EybXVOUjYxNHJGbF9EdER3amtPNTR6YTd6RktvOElLQjR6cWMtLWY5OXRCdnd3QUsyVDdIX2Zsb3c4WWhRTElkYXF4cw)
- [奥登回忆CBA：半年赚百万美元，每天一包烟](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNdkZRSXJaXzZ2aUFrYlZNQjk2bDd0eXJEMzVHZGwyNUExOGpHQm8wcUViNDNrMllCMFhXQVN5cXRNZUtWaUtCWkpWRkVLbVdIenFmMS1hXzBzbEFDM0hhRU5acDM0ZGtJQ21yR3o1QWRSV2pFZ3JzZE4xU2Q2UHpPUnlR)

CBA选秀新规与外援流失构成双重挑战，联赛需在制度与吸引力上同时破局。
篮球.en:
Chinese basketball saw significant policy and personnel moves today. A new regulation mandates that all college players must enter the CBA draft before joining the NBL, streamlining the talent pipeline. Former NBA player Alize Johnson (formerly of the Shenzhen Leopards) is nearing a deal with Paris Basketball, while Greg Oden reminisced about his CBA stint earning $1 million in six months. Additionally, young guard Cao Zhihao outlined his defensive identity and aspirations, and a retrospective looked at CBA draft picks who attempted NBA careers.

- [New CBA rule: college players must enter draft before NBL](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilwFBVV95cUxPTFM5ZlpTTWtZaG0wM095MGU3M1kydnJnaWh4VjNrazlHaG5DXzBLckI4eVlGSXRWdTNQUDZrUllZTjJxaE9ETl8wbjFkbVZtZG1PMy1UNGIzTlY3RXJSN0xlRGhSZGpzZDdXV3lKSUlKSzE3Qm9FeEk2LURvZFppTUZ3VzVYaDlTYV9IV1pHeGpyUUY1ak9R)
- [Alize Johnson close to joining Paris Basketball](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxPQjdFUTBWcmdKNXZlZGJGVXZGd1JpTXJhNGVEM1h6el9BTnFzb0hDVlZETU1pU0xKU015MFJRb2NPejltUnNMUkUwM2d5Q2trTzlVRWsxcE9tOFhZdGlIZnBTWnB2N3B4eXVwaTNGUXhZcGRBV0dYY2pUS29kWGtCNDcyRWw0S1VvY0JFQQ)
- [Greg Oden remembers CBA: $1M in six months, smoking habit](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNdkZRSXJaXzZ2aUFrYlZNQjk2bDd0eXJEMzVHZGwyNUExOGpHQm8wcUViNDNrMllCMFhXQVN5cXRNZUtWaUtCWkpWRkVLbVdIenFmMS1hXzBzbEFDM0hhRU5acDM0ZGtJQ21yR3o1QWRSV2pFZ3JzZE4xU2Q2UHpPUnlR)
- [Cao Zhihao: defending to stand in CBA, idol James](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE5SYjhBSDBmbkpEZHRnQnUxNC1YZTl2NFQzejRtZzROMHBXS3EybXVOUjYxNHJGbF9EdER3amtPNTR6YTd6RktvOElLQjR6cWMtLWY5OXRCdnd3QUsyVDdIX2Zsb3c4WWhRTElkYXF4cw)

With the draft rule change and overseas moves, the CBA's evolving landscape signals a more structured pathway for domestic talent and continued international player flow.

羽毛球.zh:
今日羽毛球领域无重要赛事或球员新闻，唯一相关动态是印尼巴厘岛Kura Kura羽毛球场建筑设计方案在网络引起关注，该球馆由IBUKU与Studio Jencquel联合设计，以竹结构为特色，体现了体育设施与自然美学的融合。

- [画廊 Kura Kura 羽毛球场 / IBUKU + Studio Jencquel](https://news.google.)

竞技层面虽平淡，但建筑设计话题为羽毛球运动增添了跨界趣味。
羽毛球.en:
There is no competitive badminton news today. The only story under this desk is an architectural feature on the Kura Kura badminton court in Bali, designed by IBUKU and Studio Jencquel. While not sport-related, it highlights an innovative venue design.

- [Gallery: Kura Kura badminton court / IBUKU + Studio Jencquel](https://news.google.)

Badminton enthusiasts will have to wait for upcoming BWF tournaments for on-court action.

虎扑社区动态.zh:

虎扑社区动态.en:

欧美.zh:
欧美板块今日重量级新闻密集。BTS抵制格莱美引发连锁反应，格莱美CEO Harvey Mason Jr.先后通过Rolling Stone和Deadline发声，表示“伤心但尊重决定”，并强调亚洲流行奖项“不是为了分裂”。Tom Holland自曝《蜘蛛侠：崭新一日》早期剪辑版令人“讨厌”，最终版成败将在本周末票房揭晓——该片目标瞄准2026年最高开画纪录。此外，Ben Affleck与Jeopardy冠军Jamie Ding联手赢得《百万富翁》100万美元奖金（捐给其刚果倡议基金会），延续去年Matt Damon的胜利。Tame Impala与Blackpink成员Jennie在波士顿首次现场合作《Dracula》，刷新舞台期待。

- [BTS不提交格莱美，CEO回应](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bts-grammys-arirang-wont-submit-2027-awards-ceo-responds-1235600777/)
- [Tom Holland透露蜘蛛侠早期剪辑版“令人讨厌”](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-spider-man-brand-new-day-cut-he-hated-1237012949/)

欧美.en:
The Western entertainment desk is buzzing with the Grammys-BTS standoff, Spider-Man's box office ambitions, and Ben Affleck's game show win. A literary spat over 'The Odyssey' adaptation and a new Korean reality spinoff on Disney+ also command attention.
- **Grammys CEO 'Saddened' by BTS Withdrawal, Defends Asian Pop Category**: Harvey Mason Jr. responded to BTS's boycott after the new category was added, calling it a move to 'celebrate' rather than divide. The decision could reshape how the Academy engages with global pop ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/grammy-ceo-saddened-bts-withdrawal-defends-asian-pop-1237012911/), [Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/music/music-industry-news/grammys-ceo-comment-bts-grammy-submissions-1236659772/)).
- **Spider-Man: Brand New Day Targets Record Opening**: The film aims to be the highest-grossing domestic opening of 2026, potentially calming fears of superhero fatigue. Tom Holland's admission of a hated early cut adds behind-the-scenes drama ([Hollywood Reporter](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/movies/movie-news/spider-man-brand-new-day-box-office-opening-tom-holland-1236659734/), [Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/tom-holland-spider-man-brand-new-day-cut-he-hated-1237012949/)).
- **Ben Affleck Wins $1M for Charity on 'Who Wants to Be a Millionaire'**: The actor's win for his Eastern Congo Initiative continues a trend of celebrities leveraging game shows for philanthropy. Matt Damon won the same prize last year ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/ben-affleck-wins-1-million-who-wants-to-be-a-millionaire-1236823747/)).
- **Joyce Carol Oates Defends Nolan's 'The Odyssey'**: Oates' fiery rebuttal to translator Emily Wilson's negative review underscores deep cultural divisions over adaptation faithfulness ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/joyce-carol-oates-the-odyssey-slams-translator-review-1236823922/)).
- **Disney+ Korea Greenlights 'House of Fates'**: The spinoff of the record-breaking 'Battle of Fates' will send guests on fortune-telling tours across Korea, hosted by the original show's top readers ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/07/disney-plus-korea-battle-of-fates-spin-off-house-of-fates-1237006528/)).

BTS's Grammy boycott and Spider-Man's box office performance are the two key signals to watch in the coming days for their impact on the broader entertainment industry.

日韩.zh:
日韩板块最大新闻无疑是BTS拒绝提交2027年格莱美，但该事件已被欧美板块详述，此处聚焦其他动态。Disney+韩国的现象级真人秀《命运之战》确认制作衍生剧《命运之屋》，原班团队将带观众探访韩国灵性圣地。fromis_9宣布亚洲巡演“TOMORROW GLOW”，9月从首尔启程。ILLIT与LE SSERAFIM凭借流媒体成绩获得日本唱片协会（RIAJ）白金认证，显示K-pop在日本的渗透力。此外，演员金智珉与金俊浩宣布怀孕，预计明年升格父母；文佳煐更换新经纪公司Fantagio后曝光全新形象照。

- [Disney+确认衍生剧《命运之屋》](https://deadline.com/2026/07/disney-plus-korea-battle-of-fates-spin-off-house-of-fates-1237006528/)
- [fromis_9亚洲巡演公告](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858411wpp/fromis_9-announces-2026-asia-tour-tomorrow-glow)

日韩.en:
The Korean entertainment desk is dominated by BTS's Grammy boycott, K-pop group tours, and actor news. The brand reputation rankings show BTS at the top despite the controversy, while fromis_9 announces an Asia tour.
- **BTS Boycott Grammys Over New Asian Pop Category**: The group's decision not to submit for 2027 Grammys, despite 'Arirang's' record-breaking success, has sparked global debate. The Recording Academy CEO responded defensively ([Hindustan Times via Google News](https://news.google.)).
- **July Star Brand Reputation: BTS Leads, Followed by Other Acts**: The Korean Business Research Institute ranked BTS first for July, based on big data analysis from June 28 to July 28 ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858424wpp/july-star-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-4)).
- **fromis_9 Announces 2026 Asia Tour 'TOMORROW GLOW.'**: The group will kick off with three nights in Seoul in September, with more dates to be announced ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858411wpp/fromis_9-announces-2026-asia-tour-tomorrow-glow)).
- **ILLIT and LE SSERAFIM Earn RIAJ Platinum Certifications**: Both groups achieved streaming platinum in Japan, a sign of sustained K-pop popularity in the market ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858421wpp/illit-and-le-sserafim-earn-riaj-platinum-certifications-for-streaming-in-japan)).
- **Actor News: Kim Ji Min and Kim Joon Ho Expecting First Child**: The couple announced the pregnancy via Instagram, adding a personal angle to the industry ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1858500wpp/kim-ji-min-and-kim-joon-ho-expecting-their-first-child)).

The BTS Grammy boycott is the defining story, but the continued success of K-pop acts in Japan and upcoming tours indicate the industry's resilience.

中国.zh:
中国娱乐产业今日聚焦于微短剧的资本化与国际传播。王海歌被视为“中国微短剧短片产业开拓者”，引发行业对其商业模式和内容质量的双重讨论。与此同时，中非情缘第六季影视展播在内罗毕启动，影视旅游成为新热点——有分析提出从内容创作、目的地开发到产业链协同“三个维度”发力。电通发布《真诚，自有引力》体育娱乐趋势2.0报告，直击中国文娱体育生态。此外，A股影视传媒板块获得北向资金加仓，外资机构密集调研，显示对中国娱乐市场信心回升。杨幂历年电视剧被盘点，虽为题外话，但反映出其长尾关注度。

中国.en:
China's entertainment scene this week features the expansion of 'China-Africa' cultural exchange, a focus on micro-short dramas as a rising industry, and strong foreign investment inflows into entertainment companies. Academic and industry reports also point to synergies between film and tourism.
- **'China-Africa Love' Sixth Season Film Exhibition Launches in Nairobi**: The event continues a cultural exchange initiative showcasing Chinese films in Africa ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxOS0QzS0xuVFJ6OU9ULUZTZjJCQ05IVnRuRlJjS3c0QlZHeERCN0NjZFdwWG1sS0NjSFh2TEV4cFFiZnlyS2pHVnFxaFMybFZkN2VGQXpNX0dSd0VFS0lxYThRTVhXZm5IbEI3NXNFbVdsd2RVbnBxcXlOQUJKYkpFZ0xPbGRJZFpxZ1RN)).
- **Wang Haige: Pioneer of China's Micro-Short Drama Industry**: An article profiles Wang Haige as a trailblazer in the fast-growing micro-short drama sector, which has drawn significant investment and regulatory attention ([中华网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBCd1JpNjB6cURZT1pmdVdxenA4N1RVQzJjMGkxM3oyNjZic1RZU1EyZnR5NDl5T3Q3TllycEExb3RNS3hnMk4tZFZFRVJNclpFMjZCd2JHWG0xV3dwbWc)).
- **Foreign Capital Flows into Chinese Entertainment**: A report on Sina Finance notes that northbound capital (foreign investment via Hong Kong) has been buying into entertainment stocks, with institutions conducting research visits ([新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMickFVX3lxTE1aZ3kwaV84VllmQkVIY0FxWWhYVTJJYVVNQkt6SlFlbUtLYURrVnozdXlNTkhiWm5WODJXSjBIOHltckpfUGltOEJVbXZfMm9DRmwtclRwVldKTHpWWjNDYmtqSXRuMl90b3pEQmRoTTZJQQ)).
- **Three Dimensions to Develop Film Tourism**: An opinion piece suggests leveraging IP, location, and infrastructure to boost film-induced tourism in China ([School of Visual Arts](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMifkFVX3lxTE1xNEsyczRjSWtjTGx5Zzd1WlZaekZaSFVEalJtSXZpbGZreGZLQi1INDlDTTBSZ0Yxd0psc3NRRkUyQVpONExNMTFOcm5EUERPYWRfSnlNVVZvYllDdVhWVC1sUEV3ZGhObHRCdzBhMmFXc0s1dW5PY0hlTC1aUQ)).

Micro-short dramas are becoming a major investment theme, while film tourism and foreign capital inflows signal confidence in the Chinese entertainment market's growth.

微博社区动态.en:
Weibo's trending topics today revolve around fan-organized campaigns, celebrity apologies, and speculative gossip.
